past.employer_linkedin_description: Running an A/B testing program is tricky. Whether your goal is to boost website conversion, reduce cart abandonment rate, increase customer retention, or improve user experience, there’s just so much you need to do to get things right. That’s why thousands of the world's leading enterprise Brands like WMG, Ubisoft, Qualicorp, Dominos, and more look to VWO for running and scaling their digital experimentation. VWO Experience Optimization Platform started when A/B testing or CRO was considered an option and not necessary for user experience optimization. Today, any organization with a digital presence cannot consider their marketing strategy whole if they are not testing to take into account what the end-users really want. In the last 13 years, VWO’s global customer base has scaled to include brands like Vodafone, Samsung, Toyota, and eBay. Last we checked, more than 4,500 brands across the globe had run over 600,000 experiments. Our original hypothesis was to use AI for helping people build better habits to transform their lives. This attracted a passionate niche, but we couldn't build conviction that it could be a VC-scale business.

We tried another pivot to explore education and learning related ideas, but quickly discovered that building a successful consumer app today is very hard (as you're battling for attention with YouTube, Instagram, and Fortnite).

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Institute of Science (IISc) was founded in 1909 as a result of the joint efforts of Jamsetji Nusserwanji Tata, the Government of India, and the Maharaja of Mysore. In 1886, Jamsetji Tata conceived of a university of science that would work for the benefit of India, and in 1898 created an endowment for establishing such an institution. The Government of India then took up the effort, and, in consultation with scientists in England and in India, decided to locate the Institute in Bengaluru, where the Maharaja of Mysore, Shri Krishnaraja Wodeyar IV, donated 372 acres of land. The Institute was formally vested in 1909, the foundation stone was laid in 1911, and the first batch of students started their studies in the same year.Over the last century, IISc has become the premier institute for advanced scientific and technological research and education in India. Beginning with 2 departments and 21 students in 1911, today IISc has 39 departments, units, or centres, 3500 students, and about 500 academic and scientific staff, supported by 600 administrative personnel. About 2200 students are in various PhD programs, almost 900 are enrolled for various Masters degrees, whereas about 400 are registered in the newly established, research oriented, four-year Bachelor of Science (Research) programme.In recent years, the Institute has vigorously promoted interdisciplinary research. New centres such as the CiSTUP, the Robert Bosch Centre for Cyber Physical Systems and a new Centre for Brain Research (funded by a large private endowment) are expected to conduct translational research in their respective areas, in order to better connect with industry and society. With the recent construction of modern buildings, acquisition of new research facilities, and induction of a large number of new faculty members, the Institute can look forward to an era of high productivity, increasing impact, and rising prominence in the world.
past.employee_description: Under guidance of Prof. V. Nanjundiah and Prof. S. Mahadevan in Molecular Reproduction, Development and Genetics department of IISc, Bangalore, developed a quantitative model for the regulation of the bgl operon in E. coli. The prestigious summer research fellowship was awarded by the Indian Academy of Sciences.

Working under Dr. Mukund Thattai at National Center for Biological Sciences, Bangalore, developed a web based tool for predicting subclasses of proteins (belonging to a specific protein family) based on its amino acid sequence only.

Under guidance of Dr. Ram Ramaswamy, modeled the phenomenon involving synchronization of flashes in a group of fireflies (of a select species). Specifically, implemented Mirollo and Strogatz model, verified it and later expanded it to include spatial considerations.

current.employer_linkedin_description: AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. What began in Paris as a small web analytics consultancy evolved into a SaaS platform focused on conversion rate optimization, and in 2011 AB Tasty was born. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

basic_profile.name: Alix de Sagazan
basic_profile.headline: CRO & Co-founder at Wingify
basic_profile.summary: I co-founded AB Tasty, a Digital Experience Optimization platform, with Rémi Aubert in 2009.Over the next 16 years, we built the company from the ground up, reaching €65M in ARR, 300 employees, and more than 1,000 customers worldwide. Along the way, we built a truly international organization, opening offices in Paris, Cologne, Berlin, London, Madrid, Singapore, Sydney, and New York.As part of that journey, I moved to New York and spent seven years there building and scaling our US business, establishing AB Tasty in what became one of our most strategic markets.At AB Tasty, our mission has always been to empower digital teams to create amazing digital experiences. From the beginning, we believed that technology alone was not enough: the best technology needs to be combined with human expertise to help teams understand their customers, make better decisions, and continuously improve their digital experiences.In 2026, AB Tasty was acquired by Everstone Capital, a Singapore-headquartered private equity firm, and combined with our long-standing partner VWO to create Wingify.Today, Wingify is a global Agentic Experience Optimization Platform helping brands understand their customers and turn those insights into action. The platform brings together experimentation, personalization, behavioral insights, feature management, commerce optimization, and AI into one integrated suite — enabling digital teams to continuously understand, decide, act, and measure across every digital touchpoint.Together, we are now 700+ people serving more than 4,000 customers globally, with one ambition: Make every digital experience relevant.

location.raw: New York, New York, United States

With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

basic_profile.headline: Product @Wingify | Ex-founder @Blitzllama | Y Combinator W22 Alum
basic_profile.summary:
I’m a product builder obsessed with one thing: shrinking the distance between “users said this” and “we shipped that.” Today, I’m at Wingify (VWO), helping shape how feedback and insights work across web + mobile.

Before this, I co-founded Blitzllama (YC W22) - an AI-powered feedback engine for real-time, in-product insights and unified customer feedback. Blitzllama was acquired by Wingify in 2025; I solely led the entire acquisition journey from June 2025 through close, and joined VWO post-acquisition to help carry the product forward at a much larger scale.

Earlier, I led product and design at Spoyl, scaling it to 500K monthly active users and running experiments that took off across Tier-2 and Tier-3 India.

Outside work, I’m usually geeking out over gadgets, science/history rabbit holes, or tinkering with AI tools just to see what they can do.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Blitzllama makes it easy for product teams to collect and analyze product feedback.With targeted in-product surveys, you can effortlessly ask questions to users at any stage of their product journey, obtaining results in hours instead of weeks. In-the-moment surveys lead to highly contextual feedback, producing response rates of 20-70% – up to 10 times higher than email surveys.Blitzllama's GPT3-powered feedback analytics instantly categorize and translates textual feedback into topics, sentiments, and recommendations. This saves hours spent on categorizing feedback data, and all feedback is stored in a single repository, enabling you to segment historical data and construct dashboards.
past.employee_description:
Blitzllama (YC W22) started with a problem I kept running into as a product builder: teams could track every click, but struggled to understand 'why' users dropped off, hesitated, or churned. 
I co-founded Blitzllama and ran GTM, product, and design - building the platform, the narrative, and the motion in parallel. We helped teams capture in-product feedback in the moment, then used AI to turn it into structured insights they could ship against.

In 2025, Wingify (VWO) acquired Blitzllama. I solely led the acquisition from outreach through close, and joined VWO post-acquisition to lead integration and scale Blitzllama’s capabilities inside a much larger platform.

basic_profile.name: Rémi Aubert
basic_profile.headline: CCO / CSO & co-Founder at Wingify
basic_profile.summary:
I am an entrepreneur in the user experience space. I co-founded AB Tasty with Alix de Sagazan. What started as a small team of two has grown into a thriving company with 300 employees, raising $60 million in funding and achieving profitability.

My journey at AB Tasty has allowed me to experience all the phases of building a tech company—from hyper-growth to large-scale recruitment, as well as navigating more challenging restructuring periods. We’ve completed 4 strategic acquisitions and developed structured approaches to product, pricing, go-to-market, sales, finance, and HR. I also manage multidisciplinary teams, blending internal growth with the recruitment of external experienced talent.

As a first-time entrepreneur, I’ve built expertise in both the bottom line and top line, which has helped me steer AB Tasty to a leadership position in its market. My goal is to continue innovating and transforming the user experience through the solutions we develop.

In addition to my role at AB Tasty, I serve on the boards of several companies, including The Galion Project, FairJungle, Synbird, and JoinStories, where I provide strategic and growth expertise.

current.employee_description:
Co-founded AB Tasty with Alix de Sagazan. Over 16 years, built it from a Paris web-analytics consultancy into the leading experience optimization platforms worldwide, then combined it with VWO in 2026.
 
2010–2013 · From consulting to SaaS
Started as Liwio, a web analytics consultancy. Turned it into a software company and launched a visual A/B testing tool that marketers could use without writing code.
 
2014–2017 · International expansion
First round of €1.1M from Kima Ventures and XAnge (2014), then €5M with Omnes Capital (2016) and a €17M Series B with Partech and Korelya Capital (2017). Opened offices in London, Madrid, Cologne and Sydney, with clients in ~40 countries. Acquired Nirror (session replay, 2016). Opened New York and San Francisco.
 
2018–2021 · Hyper-scale
Opened Singapore and obtained a Chinese ICP licence to serve clients in China (2018). Launched Flagship, for feature flagging and server-side experimentation (2019). Raised a €40M Series C led by Crédit Mutuel Innovation (2020), bringing total funding to €63M+. US revenue grew 480% in two years. Joined the French Tech Next40 (2021).
 
2022–2025 · Building the platform through M&A
Four acquisitions to build an all-in-one optimization suite:
Epoq (Germany, 2022): AI recommendations and search
Dotaki (France, 2023): emotion-based personalization
Potions (France, 2024): cookieless merchandising
Wandz.ai (Israel, 2025): real-time predictive personalization for anonymous visitors
Grew from ~60 people (2016) to 300+ across 11–13 offices in Europe, North America and APAC, serving 1,000+ brands.
 
2026 · Combination with VWO to create Wingify
Combined AB Tasty with VWO, backed by Everstone Capital. The new group has $100M+ ARR, 4,000+ customers and ~800 people.
 
Clients over the years included L'Oréal, LVMH, Kering, Sephora, YSL Beauty, Kiehl's, Urban Decay, Ulta Beauty, McDonald's, Disneyland Paris, Samsonite, USA Today, Ganni, Ashley Furniture....

AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. What began in Paris as a small web analytics consultancy evolved into a SaaS platform focused on conversion rate optimization, and in 2011 AB Tasty was born. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

Depuis 40 ans, JEECE rayonne dans le mouvement des Junior-Entreprises de France. Membre de la CNJE (Confédération Nationale des Junior-Entreprises), elle est également l’un des initiateurs du mouvement JEIDF (Juniors d’Ile-de-France) créé en début d’année 2016 et qui vise à fédérer les Juniors de la région parisienne.JEECE est une association de la loi 1901 à but non lucratif. Elle propose une expertise dans le développement informatique, l'électronique, dans l'audit-conseil-formation de systèmes d'information, ainsi que dans l'environnement. JEECE propose des solutions sur-mesure à ses clients grâce aux intervenants recrutés au sein de l’école. Nous garantissons ainsi que nos solutions sont au fait des dernières avancées technologiques et digitales. Elle accompagne ainsi les entreprises de A à Z dans leurs projets de transformation digitale.JEECE a pour vocation de faire monter en compétence les élèves ingénieurs de l'école dans laquelle elle est implantée et contribue ainsi à enrichir les projets RSE des entreprises. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

current.employer_linkedin_description: Kahoona was founded in 2022 by Gal Rapoport and Alon Ashkenasi - AI, privacy, cybersecurity, and behavioral analytics experts who previously led personalization at Amazon.Every AI or intelligent system, from personalization engines, data platforms, fraud & risk solutions, to conversational AI agents, suffer from the AI cold-start problem. They cannot generate context about the actor, user or agent, before identity exists and depend on it to function. The web was never built with a context layer, and every system built on top of it is unable to understand and act on >96% of the actors on the web.Kahoona is the context generation layer of the web, an AI infrastructure that gives every digital property the ability to understand every visitor or agent before identity exists. It generates decision-ready context, with a privacy-by-design approach (no PII), with a site-native script that reads anonymous actors and their Digital Body Language (Kahoona’s unique HCI data modality) and with site-specific AI models Kahoona serves continuously learnt context both for the enterprise teams and for the end-users. Kahoona is focusing on ‘how’ actors behave rather than ‘what’ they do. Kahoona does not enrich, match, or aggregate existing data. It generates intelligence that did not exist before.The adaptive intelligence is live, persistent and feeds every downstream system that needs to understand, decide and act: It is the input layer that digital stacks were always missing.Winner of the LVMH Award for Best Business Impact, and Kering Innovation Award, Kahoona’s AI Hyper-Personalization is scaling across digital and omnichannel teams within ecommerce brands, CPG  & retail, travel & hospitality, financial services & insurance, telecom, and more. Headquartered in New York.
current.employee_description: Kahoona is AI infrastructure that generates real-time, decision-ready context on any website visitor or AI agent, before identity exists. basic_profile.name: Jan Marks
basic_profile.headline: Founder & Publisher at Conversion.News | Bringing the CRO community together | Experimentation, Personalization & Digital Growth
basic_profile.summary: Conversion Optimization works best when people share what they learn. That is something smart people in the CRO space taught me, and it is why we are building Conversion.News.Conversion.News will be the media house for the Conversion Optimization community and industry. We are bringing people together in three places: our digital channel, our podcast and regional Conversion Days.Across all three, we are focusing on what makes people and companies more successful in CRO: best practices and cases, tools and innovations, agencies and experts, insights and events.For partners and contributors, Conversion.News will offer visibility and access to a highly relevant audience. For companies building or scaling their CRO programs, we will help find the right technology and the right expertise.I decided to start this because I have seen CRO from three sides: As a business, when the travel giant TUI wondered what to do with the internet, and as Managing Director of lastminute.com after the dotcom crash, when we learned that buying traffic was no longer enough. As an agency, where I helped clients of Multiplica launch and scale successful CRO programs. And as a technology provider at VWO, where I got to know the SaaS business from the inside.All three taught me the same lesson: digital growth requires three Ps, the right Platforms, People and Processes. And that is what Conversion.News is all about.Got a story, a case or a question about CRO? Let’s talk!

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Birla Institute of Technology & Science (BITS), Pilani is a prestigious Indian university for higher education in science, technology and humanities. BITS Pilani has consistently ranked amongst the top universities in India. The acceptance rate of BITS Pilani is 1.47% making it the most selective university in India.The primary motive of BITS is to "train young men and women able and eager to create and put into action such ideas, methods, techniques and information". The Institute is a dream come true of its founder late Mr G.D.Birla - an eminent industrialist, a participant in Indian freedom struggle and a close associate of the Father of Indian Nation late Mr. Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi (Mahatma Gandhi). What started in early 1900s as a small school, blossomed into a set of colleges for higher education, ranging from the Humanities to Engineering until 1964 when all these colleges amalgamated to culminate into a unique Indian University of International standing. This university was christened as the Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani, known to many as BITS, Pilani.Over the years, BITS has provided the highest quality technical education to students from all over India admitted on the basis of merit. Its graduates may be found throughout the world in all areas of engineering, science and commerce. BITS symbolizes the maturing of Indian technical ability and "can-do" entrepreneurial spirit, especially as derived from the private sector. BITS is located in the Vidya Vihar campus adjacent to the town of Pilani in Rajasthan.Admission is merit-based, as assessed by the online BITSAT examination. The fully residential institute is privately supported.

past.employer_linkedin_description: AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. What began in Paris as a small web analytics consultancy evolved into a SaaS platform focused on conversion rate optimization, and in 2011 AB Tasty was born. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

Engineering leader with 17+ years of experience delivering scalable systems, leading cross-functional teams, and driving innovation across SaaS, web experimentation, digital identity, and AI.

Currently serving as Director of Engineering at VWO, where I lead platform engineering with a strong focus on growth, monetization, and integration strategy. My work spans:

🔹 Cloud Infrastructure & Observability at Scale

The Sonatype journey started 15 years ago, just as the concept of “open source” software development was gaining steam. From our humble beginning as core contributors to Apache Maven, to supporting the world’s largest repository of open source components (Central), to distributing the world's most popular repository manager (Sonatype Nexus Repository), we’ve played a meaningful role in helping the world embrace the power of open innovation.Over time, we witnessed the staggering volume and variety of open source libraries that began flowing into every development environment in the world. We understood that when open source components are properly managed, they provide a tremendous energy for accelerating innovation.  Conversely, when unmanaged, open source "gone wild" can lead directly to security vulnerabilities, licensing risks, enormous rework, and waste.Our vision today is simple.We are laser focused on helping organizations continuously harness all of the good that open source has to offer, without any of the risk. In order to do this, we have invested in knowing more about the quality of open source than anyone else in the world. This investment takes the form of machine learning, artificial intelligence, and human expertise, which in aggregate produces highly curated intelligence that is infused into every Sonatype product. Organizations equipped with Sonatype products make better decisions, innovate faster at scale, and rest comfortably knowing that their applications always consist of the highest quality open source components.

current.employer_linkedin_description: AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. What began in Paris as a small web analytics consultancy evolved into a SaaS platform focused on conversion rate optimization, and in 2011 AB Tasty was born. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

past.employer_linkedin_description: Depuis 1933, la compagnie Air France porte haut les couleurs de la France à travers le monde entier. Avec une activité, répartie entre le transport aérien de passagers, le fret, la maintenance et l’entretien aéronautique, Air France est un acteur majeur du secteur aérien. Plus de 42 000 collaborateurs se mobilisent au quotidien pour proposer à chaque client, une expérience de voyage unique. Air France, KLM Royal Dutch Airlines et Transavia forment le Groupe Air France-KLM. Le Groupe  s’appuie sur la force de ses hubs de Paris-Charles de Gaulle et d’Amsterdam-Schiphol pour offrir un vaste réseau international. Son programme de fidélité Flying Blue rassemble plus de 17 millions d’adhérents. Air France et KLM sont membres de l’alliance SkyTeam qui compte au total, 19 compagnies aériennes.Air France place la santé et la sécurité de ses clients et de ses personnels au cœur de ses préoccupations. Avec Air France Protect, son engagement sanitaire, la compagnie a instauré les mesures sanitaires les plus strictes pour un voyage en toute sécurité. Air France s’est fixé des objectifs ambitieux en matière de développement durable et travaille à réduire et compenser ses émissions de CO2.  Dans le cadre du programme Horizon 2030, la compagnie s’est engagée à réduire de 50% ses émissions de CO2 par passager-kilomètre d’ici à 2030 à travers des investissements importants en faveur du renouvellement de sa flotte par des avions de nouvelle génération, l’utilisation de solutions innovantes pour réduire sa consommation de carburant ou encore l’utilisation progressive de carburants alternatifs durables.Plus d'informations sur : corporate.airfrance.com

past.employer_linkedin_description: AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. What began in Paris as a small web analytics consultancy evolved into a SaaS platform focused on conversion rate optimization, and in 2011 AB Tasty was born. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

current.employer_linkedin_description: AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. What began in Paris as a small web analytics consultancy evolved into a SaaS platform focused on conversion rate optimization, and in 2011 AB Tasty was born. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com

basic_profile.summary: I co-founded AB Tasty, a Digital Experience Optimization platform, with Rémi Aubert in 2009.Over the next 16 years, we built the company from the ground up, reaching €65M in ARR, 300 employees, and more than 1,000 customers worldwide. current.employee_description:
Co-founded AB Tasty with Alix de Sagazan. Over 16 years, built it from a Paris web-analytics consultancy into the leading experience optimization platforms worldwide, then combined it with VWO in 2026.
 
2010–2013 · From consulting to SaaS
Started as Liwio, a web analytics consultancy. Turned it into a software company and launched a visual A/B testing tool that marketers could use without writing code.
 
2014–2017 · International expansion
First round of €1.1M from Kima Ventures and XAnge (2014), then €5M with Omnes Capital (2016) and a €17M Series B with Partech and Korelya Capital (2017). Opened offices in London, Madrid, Cologne and Sydney, with clients in ~40 countries. Acquired Nirror (session replay, 2016). Opened New York and San Francisco.
 
2018–2021 · Hyper-scale
Opened Singapore and obtained a Chinese ICP licence to serve clients in China (2018). Launched Flagship, for feature flagging and server-side experimentation (2019). Raised a €40M Series C led by Crédit Mutuel Innovation (2020), bringing total funding to €63M+. US revenue grew 480% in two years. Joined the French Tech Next40 (2021).
 
2022–2025 · Building the platform through M&A
Four acquisitions to build an all-in-one optimization suite:
Epoq (Germany, 2022): AI recommendations and search
Dotaki (France, 2023): emotion-based personalization
Potions (France, 2024): cookieless merchandising
Wandz.ai (Israel, 2025): real-time predictive personalization for anonymous visitors
Grew from ~60 people (2016) to 300+ across 11–13 offices in Europe, North America and APAC, serving 1,000+ brands.
 
2026 · Combination with VWO to create Wingify
Combined AB Tasty with VWO, backed by Everstone Capital. The new group has $100M+ ARR, 4,000+ customers and ~800 people.
 
Clients over the years included L'Oréal, LVMH, Kering, Sephora, YSL Beauty, Kiehl's, Urban Decay, Ulta Beauty, McDonald's, Disneyland Paris, Samsonite, USA Today, Ganni, Ashley Furniture....

current.employer_linkedin_description: AB Tasty started when two founders, Alix de Sagazan and Rémi Aubert, struck out on their own with a simple idea: experimentation and personalization should be faster and easier for marketers. What began in Paris as a small web analytics consultancy evolved into a SaaS platform focused on conversion rate optimization, and in 2011 AB Tasty was born. With a test-and-learn mindset at its heart, they grew the business step by step—from just 10 employees and 25 customers in France in 2014 into a truly global company.Today, AB Tasty employs more than 300 people across offices in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond, serving over 1,000 customers around the world. That growth was fueled by a series of major funding rounds—a $6M Series A in 2016, a $17M Series B in 2018 and a $40M Series C in 2020—and several acquisitions that expanded its technology and reach. Along the way, the company built a strong track record of results: consistently recognized as a Leader in G2 reports and trusted by some of the world's biggest brands, from LVMH and Lancôme to Booking.com, with measurable wins including a 15% revenue increase for Lancôme.In 2026, AB Tasty opened its next chapter by coming together with VWO under Wingify, creating a combined global leader serving more than 4,000 customers and generating over $100 million in annual revenue. Alix and Rémi remain at the heart of that journey, with Alix as Chief Revenue Officer and Rémi as Chief Strategy and Customer Experience Officer.From a small team in Paris to a global company and now a new chapter as Wingify, the spirit remains the same: keep experimenting and keep learning.Learn more at Wingify.com
current.employee_description:
Co-founded AB Tasty with Alix de Sagazan. Over 16 years, built it from a Paris web-analytics consultancy into the leading experience optimization platforms worldwide, then combined it with VWO in 2026.
 
2010–2013 · From consulting to SaaS
Started as Liwio, a web analytics consultancy. Turned it into a software company and launched a visual A/B testing tool that marketers could use without writing code.
 
2014–2017 · International expansion
First round of €1.1M from Kima Ventures and XAnge (2014), then €5M with Omnes Capital (2016) and a €17M Series B with Partech and Korelya Capital (2017). Opened offices in London, Madrid, Cologne and Sydney, with clients in ~40 countries. Acquired Nirror (session replay, 2016). Opened New York and San Francisco.
 
2018–2021 · Hyper-scale
Opened Singapore and obtained a Chinese ICP licence to serve clients in China (2018). Launched Flagship, for feature flagging and server-side experimentation (2019). Raised a €40M Series C led by Crédit Mutuel Innovation (2020), bringing total funding to €63M+. US revenue grew 480% in two years. Joined the French Tech Next40 (2021).
 
2022–2025 · Building the platform through M&A
Four acquisitions to build an all-in-one optimization suite:
Epoq (Germany, 2022): AI recommendations and search
Dotaki (France, 2023): emotion-based personalization
Potions (France, 2024): cookieless merchandising
Wandz.ai (Israel, 2025): real-time predictive personalization for anonymous visitors
Grew from ~60 people (2016) to 300+ across 11–13 offices in Europe, North America and APAC, serving 1,000+ brands.
 
2026 · Combination with VWO to create Wingify
Combined AB Tasty with VWO, backed by Everstone Capital. The new group has $100M+ ARR, 4,000+ customers and ~800 people.
 
Clients over the years included L'Oréal, LVMH, Kering, Sephora, YSL Beauty, Kiehl's, Urban Decay, Ulta Beauty, McDonald's, Disneyland Paris, Samsonite, USA Today, Ganni, Ashley Furniture....

basic_profile.summary: I’m a business and revenue leader with experience scaling B2B SaaS organizations through enterprise sales, strategic partnerships, and team leadership—from early-stage growth through successful exits.  I've worked across multiple stages of company growth, from early-stage startups to global enterprises like Google. I enjoy helping technical companies translate innovation into commercial success by developing repeatable customer use cases and building long-term enterprise partnerships. I believe great results come from empowered people. My background as both a competitive athlete and professional coach shaped the player-coach leadership style I bring to business—leading from the front, developing others, and putting talented people in positions to succeed.  I've held both individual contributor and leadership roles across the commercial organization, giving me a unique perspective on building pipeline, winning strategic enterprise customers, and scaling revenue teams. I personally know how to hunt, close, and manage strategic enterprise deals.  Over the past decade, I've helped B2B SaaS and DaaS companies grow through global enterprise sales, strategic partnerships, and business development across North America, EMEA, and APAC. I specialize in opening new markets, building teams from scratch, and helping innovative technology companies establish product-market fit and scale repeatable commercial organizations. I've contributed to two successful startup exits, including BreezoMeter's acquisition by Google ($250M+). At BreezoMeter, I built several of the company's most strategic enterprise relationships from the ground up—from initial market discovery through long-term commercial partnerships—helping drive growth and contributing to the company's successful exit.

basic_profile.name: Michael Ayele
basic_profile.headline: Director of Innovation & Strategic Growth | 2x Exits (Breezometer, WalkMe) | SaaS, AI, Climate & Digital Health | GTM & Post-Sales | Trusted by CVS, 3M, NIH, Enbridge, Samsung, Yahoo | Forecasting Flu, Asthma & Wildfires
basic_profile.current_title: Director of Strategic Partnerships, Customer Growth and Innovation
basic_profile.summary:
I help enterprise organizations drive measurable outcomes and revenue growth by owning the full customer lifecycle, from solution design and initial sale through adoption, expansion, and strategic partnerships.

Over the past decade, I’ve worked across high-growth startups and global organizations like Google, WalkMe (acquired by SAP), BreezoMeter, and now at Ambee, leading initiatives in strategic partnerships, enterprise expansion, and go-to-market execution across industries including HealthTech, ClimateTech, AI, and B2B SaaS. 

I specialize in driving Saas growth in complex, regulated environments, leading multi-stakeholder relationships across digital health, public sector, geospatial data, and privacy-sensitive use cases.

At Ambee, I lead conversations that turn environmental intelligence into business impact, partnering with clients in healthcare, consumer tech, pharma, automotive, and government to build solutions that go far beyond data delivery. Whether it’s launching forecasting tools, validating geospatial accuracy, or aligning with GTM and product strategy, my role blends strategic selling with deep cross-functional collaboration across Product, Data Science, and Marketing to drive retention, adoption, and long-term growth. 

Unraveling the complexity of large organizations and turning that into clarity and momentum has been one of the most rewarding parts of my journey. I’ve had the privilege of working with brands like CVS, 3M, Starbucks, Enbridge, Kenvue (J&J), NIH, Yahoo, and Blueair solving layered challenges, expanding partnerships, and helping teams move from friction to flow. 

What drives me most is the opportunity to acquire the right customers, grow with them through relevance and trust, and keep solving higher-order challenges as their world evolves. 

What I bring: 
> Enterprise SaaS experience across health, climate, and AI/data-driven verticals 
> Leadership in API-first, product-led, and customer-focused environments 
> Experience in strategic sales, onboarding, retention, and account growth 
> A systems approach to GTM with a human-centered mindset 

Outside of work... I’ve spent the past 14+ years on a meditation and spiritual journey...a path that’s deeply shaped how I lead, listen, and live. That journey is slowly becoming a book... in due time. 

And also, I’m a massive English Premier League fan. I won’t say which team I support here (too risky 😉)... but feel free to DM me if you’re curious (or brave). 

If you’re building something meaningful, especially in climate, health, or AI-powered platforms, let’s connect.

basic_profile.name: Devesh Aggrawal
basic_profile.headline: Co-Founder & CTO at TransactBridge | Payments Expert | Blockchain Architect
basic_profile.summary:
Detail-oriented, responsible, and committed tech-savvy, with a get-it-done, on-time, and high-quality product spirit, and having experience defining requirements, architecting, implementing, testing, delivering complex solutions using a variety of technologies. 

I love writing code, from writing my first python project of 2048 game, and manipulating it to produce the desired output, I have been obsessed with the idea of using software to solve practical problems. I am a blockchain techie possessing the thought process of a hacker. My personal motto is to "Think like a businessman while acting like a serviceman" and has been a fan of the "Try your self" approach. I believe in the power of programming to transform and improve the lives of people around the world.

With a vision of a decentralized ecosystem, currently brainstorming on different approaches that can help us to achieve the true Web 3.0 internet.

Feel free to reach out I'm always up if you keep things interesting.

basic_profile.summary:
So...you're here reading my profile!

First off, thanks for taking the time. This most likely means we don't know each other yet...

And with that in mind, there's really no point in me trying to sell Xeno to you. We've only just met!

So at this point, you have a few options :)

basic_info.description: vowels is a New York brand made in Tokyo. The practice runs on contrast, the way jazz does: knowing the codes well enough to play against them. current.employer_linkedin_description: Extramarks is among the fastest growing educational technology companies, with a global footprint. The company has a huge presence in India, South Africa, Indonesia and the Middle East. Extramarks has revolutionized the way education is perceived and delivered, custom creating learning solutions for the 21st century learner.We are a team of exceptional academics, technology experts and visualizers, who help simplify textbook learning through rich media based modules.Our efforts are supported by a 2000 strong sales team, present pan-India, which helps us reach directly to the final consumer. We have recently pressed the pedal to increase the sales momentum, opening offices in close to 70 cities, reaching hitherto unexplored geographies and people. Extramarks was founded in 2007 by Mr. Atul Kulshrestha, the visionary and transformative mind who has been leading the disruptions in the edtech domain from the front. In the past decade, a family of more than 3500 employees has come together to carry forth the Extramarks mission. Our product range is huge! From pre-school, to extensive K12 coverage, going over to higher studies and competitive exams, we have it all. We are also disrupting the coaching segment through the Extramarks Smart Coaching Centres, present in 17 cities with 23 centres. These centres provide coaching for IIT-JEE, NEET and Foundation courses, through latest classroom technology and India’s top faculty. Students love learning with us! Our learners exceed 6 million in number and they spend an average of 97 minutes per day on our platform.Working at Extramarks provides the unique opportunity to become a part of this learning revolution taking place in India, where more and more students are shifting towards the digital mode of education.Ideate with us. Visualise with us. Create with us. Grow with us. Reach out to us.
current.employee_description:
At Extramarks, our primary focus revolves around the challenge of education, which essentially boils down to engaging students meaningfully. How do we spark curiosity? How do we instill a passion for learning? How do we optimize retention? How do we tailor learning experiences? How do we ‘Make Learning Fun’? These are the questions driving our efforts in the K12 and JEE NEET Test Prep segments in India.

Through digitally enabled smart classes for schools and institutes, a teaching application for educators, and a student application for students, we've pioneered a unique school-to-home connected ecosystem. This Extramarks ecosystem allows us to monitor students' educational progress comprehensively and offer guidance to teachers, parents, schools, and students in the shape of educational and technological tools which can be used by them to steer the student in the right direction.

current.employee_description:
While almost all industries worldwide have embraced technology, the fashion industry has yet to find its footing in this regard. Can we integrate technology into fashion to eradicate counterfeiting? Is there a way of enhancing your fashion experience through technology? Imagine a stylish hoodie with an in-built temperature sensor that changes color to regulate your body temperature. Or GPS-enabled track pants that track your steps while you're out on a run. While such innovative apparel may be years, even decades, away, the possibilities are endless!

At Vowels, we've embraced the Japanese concept of Shu Ha Ri: "Learn – Detach – Transcend." First, we accepted fashion for what it is and developed a luxury streetwear fashion line of the highest quality. Then, we detached ourselves from conventional notions and boundaries surrounding fashion, and finally, we transcended by integrating technological solutions into our fashion lines.

Our first-ever collection of luxury streetwear is launching soon! Stay tuned on www.vowels.net!

past.employer_linkedin_description: Noah is an American men's clothing brand founded by Brendon Babenzien, based out of its flagship store on 195 Mulberry St. in Soho, New York City. Brendon’s free-thinking vision has long been at the heart of the movement merging the rebellious vitality of skate, surf, and music cultures with an innovative appreciation of classic menswear. Noah was created to realize this vision fully, in uncompromising pursuit of quality, integrity, and originality.As a brand, Noah seeks to take a stand against many of the appalling practices of the fashion industry. Our clothes are made in countries, mills and factories where tradition, expertise and human dignity take precedence over the bottom line. We donate portions of our profits to causes we believe in. We speak out on issues we find important, and try to help give voice to the people and organizations we care about. We do this humbly, but with a firm belief that a responsible brand is a healthy one; that putting our values on the line pushes us to do our best.The interests and influences that inspire our clothing fall under a large, inclusive, cross-generational umbrella. Our ideas come as much from the possibilities we see in fabrics and designs as our commitment to living active, engaged lifestyles. We believe in doing things our own way, with conviction, according to principles we determine ourselves. That’s the definition of punk rock to us, and we’re interested in the endless ways people from all walks of life manifest this attitude. We invite you to join us, both in our flagship store and online, and tell us how you do it.

Created in 2014, Aimé Leon Dore is a lifestyle, sport and ready-to-wear brand based out of Queens, New York. With a strong focus on simple yet powerful design, we are driven to create timeless work by portraying an aesthetic that is uniquely our own.

Born and raised in the hills of Florence, Ippolita has always been inspired by the richness and simplicity of Italian culture. As a young girl, she discovered her love for jewelry in the shops and stalls of Ponte Vecchio. An artist first and a designer second, Ippolita studied sculpture and ceramics for five years at the Istituto D’Arte in Florence. After working in bronze and stone on large-scale works, Ippolita was inspired to apply her aesthetic to the world of adornment when she launched her eponymous jewelry collection in 1999 in New York with Bergdorf Goodman. A reverence for women and the female body has informed her style and her design vocabulary from the start. Her highly personal approach to fine jewelry is expressed in the sculptural nature of the organic shapes of her precious metals. A proprietary blend of 18K Gold and other precious metals creates a distinctive “green” hue, flattering to all skin types while her 925 Silver is a color with a brilliance all its own. The stone cuts Ippolita uses are characterized by their artfully random, larger-than-normal facets that conspire to create plays of light and shadow against the skin. Ippolita’s jewelry is an encounter with beauty. That beauty is an experience shared – between seller and buyer, wearer and creator, lover and loved one, devotee and neophyte. It is generous, participatory, outward-facing, welcoming, and open to all. “Beauty in our everyday lives brings joy to the human experience and fosters a culture of care.”

past.employer_linkedin_description: AREA is a fashion and accessories design studio known for its quality craftsmanship, textile development, and innovative embellishment. Founded in 2014 by designers Piotrek Panszczyk and Beckett Fogg in downtown New York City, AREA has garnered a cult following with its modern and timeless take on beauty and glamour.Beckett is originally from Lexington, Kentucky, and Piotrek was born in Poland and raised in Holland. After experience at Calvin Klein Collection and Chloé, respectively, they met at Parsons while pursuing their Masters in Fashion Design and Society. The designers meld their uniquely diverse backgrounds to explore history, aspiration, and conceptualized ideas of glamour through AREA.Exploring perceptions of femininity and beauty are an ongoing reference for AREA; the ways in which these ideals evolve and change across time and cultures is a driving inspirational force for the brand. Through examining and challenging the evolution of beauty ideals, AREA celebrates duality and togetherness.AREA’s signature style is multi-faceted; witty, inherently glamorous, playfully decadent and injected with a pop energy. The brand shares its name and spirit with the iconic 80s Manhattan nightclub, known for its fusion of art and performance in conceptually-themed nights attracting an eclectic mix of uptown and downtown scenes along with international celebrities.Currently stocked at leading retailers around the globe, AREA has grown beyond its Downtown roots, spreading its ethos of inclusiveness and irreverent glamour around the globe.

past.employer_linkedin_description: As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.House rules: https://nes.tl/HouseRules

I love challenges; the kinds which push the mind to expand its boundaries and create something of lasting value for the world. The bigger and more impossible the challenge, the more irresistible it becomes to me. Whether it's pioneering technological solutions to dominate the Ed-Tech market in India at Extramarks or mixing technology and fashion to develop a Luxury Streetwear brand at Vowels Corp, I don’t deter from stepping outside my comfort zones to face challenges of any size, head on. 

If you feel like knowing more about what I do here at Extramarks or at Vowels Corp, or simply wish to exchange thoughts and ideas on the boundless realms of the future, don’t hesitate to contact me!

current.employer_linkedin_description: Extramarks is among the fastest growing educational technology companies, with a global footprint. The company has a huge presence in India, South Africa, Indonesia and the Middle East. Extramarks has revolutionized the way education is perceived and delivered, custom creating learning solutions for the 21st century learner.We are a team of exceptional academics, technology experts and visualizers, who help simplify textbook learning through rich media based modules.Our efforts are supported by a 2000 strong sales team, present pan-India, which helps us reach directly to the final consumer. We have recently pressed the pedal to increase the sales momentum, opening offices in close to 70 cities, reaching hitherto unexplored geographies and people. Extramarks was founded in 2007 by Mr. Atul Kulshrestha, the visionary and transformative mind who has been leading the disruptions in the edtech domain from the front. In the past decade, a family of more than 3500 employees has come together to carry forth the Extramarks mission. Our product range is huge! From pre-school, to extensive K12 coverage, going over to higher studies and competitive exams, we have it all. We are also disrupting the coaching segment through the Extramarks Smart Coaching Centres, present in 17 cities with 23 centres. These centres provide coaching for IIT-JEE, NEET and Foundation courses, through latest classroom technology and India’s top faculty. Students love learning with us! Our learners exceed 6 million in number and they spend an average of 97 minutes per day on our platform.Working at Extramarks provides the unique opportunity to become a part of this learning revolution taking place in India, where more and more students are shifting towards the digital mode of education.Ideate with us. Visualise with us. Create with us. Grow with us. Reach out to us.
current.employee_description:
At Extramarks, our primary focus revolves around the challenge of education, which essentially boils down to engaging students meaningfully. How do we spark curiosity? How do we instill a passion for learning? How do we optimize retention? How do we tailor learning experiences? How do we ‘Make Learning Fun’? These are the questions driving our efforts in the K12 and JEE NEET Test Prep segments in India.

Through digitally enabled smart classes for schools and institutes, a teaching application for educators, and a student application for students, we've pioneered a unique school-to-home connected ecosystem. This Extramarks ecosystem allows us to monitor students' educational progress comprehensively and offer guidance to teachers, parents, schools, and students in the shape of educational and technological tools which can be used by them to steer the student in the right direction.

current.employer_linkedin_description: vowels is a New York brand made in Tokyo. The practice runs on contrast, the way jazz does: knowing the codes well enough to play against them. Every piece holds a tension, precision with ease, restraint with subversion, the archive with the everyday, and the tension is the point.References sit at the center of the work. Silhouettes, textiles, and techniques are drawn from a growing research library and reworked with the four forces that guide everything we make: precision, memory, spirit, and timing.Established in 2024.
current.employee_description:
While almost all industries worldwide have embraced technology, the fashion industry has yet to find its footing in this regard. Can we integrate technology into fashion to eradicate counterfeiting? Is there a way of enhancing your fashion experience through technology? Imagine a stylish hoodie with an in-built temperature sensor that changes color to regulate your body temperature. Or GPS-enabled track pants that track your steps while you're out on a run. While such innovative apparel may be years, even decades, away, the possibilities are endless!

At Vowels, we've embraced the Japanese concept of Shu Ha Ri: "Learn – Detach – Transcend." First, we accepted fashion for what it is and developed a luxury streetwear fashion line of the highest quality. Then, we detached ourselves from conventional notions and boundaries surrounding fashion, and finally, we transcended by integrating technological solutions into our fashion lines.

Our first-ever collection of luxury streetwear is launching soon! Stay tuned on www.vowels.net!

basic_profile.summary:

Team Leadership: Throughout my career, I have excelled in leading and developing team members, fostering a culture of high performance and innovation.

Strategic Vision: I specialize in managing critical growth phases and building brand awareness with a long-term focus on image and reputation. I excel at elaborating strategies and designing operational systems that drive sustainable growth and expand market share.

Multilingual Abilities: Fluent in French, English, and Spanish, I can effectively communicate and collaborate on a global scale.

past.employer_linkedin_description: As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.House rules: https://nes.tl/HouseRules

basic_profile.name: Kadambari Sahu
basic_profile.headline: SVP Design ValueLabs | AI-Native Product & Experience Leader | 170+ International Design & Leadership Awards
basic_profile.summary: I build organizations, products, and capabilities that help companies navigate major technology shifts.Over the past 14+ years, I have worked across enterprise software, healthcare, insurance, financial services, telecom, travel, data platforms, and AI, leading multidisciplinary teams at the intersection of product strategy, customer experience, innovation, and organizational transformation.As SVP, Design & Head of UXG at ValueLabs, I built and scaled a multidisciplinary organization of 75+ designers, researchers, managers, and design leaders supporting hundreds of enterprise programs. I have led the transformation of teams, operating models, learning systems, and product experiences to help organizations adopt AI responsibly and effectively. basic_profile.name: Sam Alva
basic_profile.headline: Chief Executive Officer
basic_profile.summary: Twenty years. One company. 7,000 people. The privilege of serving as CEO. But the number that matters most is not any of those. It is the one behind why we built this in the first place. ValueLabs was founded by Arjun on the belief that doing the right thing and building a great business are the same thing, not tradeoffs. In the mid-nineties, Arjun's mother ran a school offering computer education to kids. When a quarter of them could not afford it, the answer was simple: everyone gets it for free. To fund that, they opened the same space for professional courses after hours. When those students graduated, Arjun helped find them jobs. One of those calls led to someone in the Bay Area saying, why don't we send you some work. The first offshore project ran out of the same school. ValueLabs was not born from a business plan. It was born from doing the right thing, repeatedly. That is still the operating system here. Most companies do not have an AI problem. They have an implementation problem. The models exist. The tools exist. What is missing is someone who can make AI work inside real workflows and real organizations. We identified that gap early. When Anthropic and OpenAI eventually built their own consulting arms to help enterprises figure out implementation, they were confirming what we had already been doing. We became customer zero before asking anyone else to transform. We rebuilt how we work around AiDE, our proprietary agentic AI platform. Every one of our 7,000 employees uses it across delivery and business processes. Independent analysts have described us as a category of one — the only enterprise-native agentic AI platform. That is not a claim we made about ourselves. It is what happens when you spend 34 months building something rather than piloting it. The foundation has always been deep partnerships and accountability. What has evolved is our ability to own outcomes directly through Transformation as a Service. We are not selling effort. We are selling outcomes. Most of our client relationships span a decade or more. Some go back twenty-five years. I think that says something. If you are navigating a meaningful transformation and want a conversation with someone who has been in the trenches for two decades, I would enjoy connecting.

basic_profile.name: Mohammed Umair Ansari
basic_profile.headline: VP - Strategic Engagements | Trusted Advisor to CXOs on Enterprise Transformation
basic_profile.summary:
One Mission. One Vision. One Goal.
To make Agentic AI deliver measurable outcomes in the real world.

I am not a consultant.
I am not a seller of AI tools.
I build and operate AI systems that move business metrics.

What I Do

I work with CXOs, operators, and public leaders to turn AI from an idea into execution systems that act, decide, and deliver.

My focus is simple:

Increase revenue
Reduce cost
Improve speed and efficiency
Do it in a governed, accountable manner

No experimentation theatre.
No endless roadmaps.
No “AI strategy” without execution.

What Makes My Approach Different

Where traditional AI predicts, I build systems that act.
Where consulting creates complexity, I simplify into execution.
Where vendors sell licenses, I take ownership of outcomes.

I design and operationalize Agentic AI systems that are embedded into day-to-day business workflows, not sitting on the side as dashboards.

What I Deliver (Across Industries)

Revenue Expansion

Autonomous pricing and promotion systems
Demand sensing and forecasting agents
Customer growth and personalization engines
B2B and channel optimization

Cost & Efficiency

Supply chain and inventory optimization
Operations automation across functions
Finance process automation (AR/AP, reconciliation, controls)
Waste, fraud, and quality reduction systems

These are not pilots.
These are production systems tied to KPIs.

My Operating Model

Outcome-Based AI.

No long-term lock-ins
No tech-first thinking
No inflated promises

You pay when the metric moves.

Revenue up. Cost down.
That’s the contract.

Where I Work

My work spans:

Enterprises across industries
Government and public sector
Smart cities and digital infrastructure
Citizen-facing systems

Because Agentic AI is not just a business lever.
It is a governance layer for how systems operate at scale.

Why It Matters

AI will either remain a cost center
or become a system that runs parts of the economy.

The difference is execution.

One Mission. One Vision. One Goal.
Agentic AI that delivers real-world outcomes.

basic_profile.name: Sumit Saha
basic_profile.headline: Strategic HRBP @ ValueLabs | HR Automation & Workforce Analytics | Leveraging AI for Operational Excellence
basic_profile.summary:
I believe the most effective HR strategies are rooted in solid business acumen and driven by digital innovation. My career didn't start in traditional HR—it started in Business Development. That foundation taught me how to manage complex pipelines, negotiate with diverse stakeholders, and align strategic solutions with core business goals.

Today, as an HR Business Partner, I apply those exact same principles internally. I treat the organization as the business, and the employees and leadership as my key stakeholders. My focus is on building scalable people operations, retaining top talent, and leveraging technology to eliminate administrative bottlenecks.
Here is what I bring to the table:

-Strategic HR Partnering: Managing end-to-end performance cycles, compliance governance, and policy adherence across fast-paced, complex IT environments.

-Digital HR & Automation: Actively championing digital transformation by building and deploying micro-tools via text-to-code platforms (AiDE). I focus on automating routine HR reporting and workflows to drastically reduce manual turnaround times.

-Data-Driven Retention: Utilizing advanced workforce analytics, attrition tracking, and structured 1-on-1 connects to identify engagement gaps and implement proactive, targeted retention interventions.

-Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnering seamlessly with Finance, IT, and business directors to align headcount planning, OKRs, and Rewards & Recognition budgets with organizational delivery targets.

I am passionate about creating workplace environments where both the business and its people thrive. Always open to connecting with fellow HR professionals, tech enthusiasts, and business leaders.

basic_profile.name: Anampally Rajesh
basic_profile.headline: Principal Performance Test Architect | AI-Driven Engineering & Cloud Reliability | AWS, Kubernetes, APM Strategy | Optimizing Enterprise Scalability & Cost | 15+ Years Experience
basic_profile.summary:
In a cloud-native world, performance isn't just about passing a test—it's about revenue, user experience, and architectural resilience.
For over 15 years, I have helped Fortune 500 enterprises in Aviation, Retail, and Fintech ensure their critical systems can handle the pressure of the real world. I specialize in the transition from traditional performance testing to Performance Engineering, shifting focus from "finding bugs" to "architecting reliability."
Currently, I am a Principal Architect leading high-impact engagements. My recent focus has been pioneering AI-driven automation frameworks, utilizing Python to reduce scripting efforts by 30% and automate root-cause analysis.

What I bring to the table:

Cloud Mastery: Deep expertise in benchmarking and tuning AWS environments (EKS, ECS, Lambda) and Kubernetes clusters.
Strategic Leadership: Leading onsite and offshore teams (US, Malaysia, India) to deliver complex projects under strict SLAs.
Full-Stack Observability: Implementing end-to-end monitoring strategies using Dynatrace, New Relic, and Datadog to visualize bottlenecks before they impact users.

basic_profile.name: Senthil Vivekanandan
basic_profile.headline: VP - Global Delivery & Engineering Transformation | Scaling Quality-First Engineering for US Enterprises | Aviation, OTT, SaaS
basic_profile.summary: Two decades at one company sounds unusual these days, so let me explain what that actually looked like. I joined ValueLabs as an entry-level engineer in 2003. Today I run global delivery as VP with 100+ engineers across India, US and Europe, 10+ accounts in aviation, OTT and SaaS. Every level in between, I did the job before I managed people doing it. Time has taught two things: how to do the work, and how not to do the work. I cannot keep working with a broken process. Process problems bother me the way a crooked photo frame bothers some people. So I fix them. Not because someone escalated. Because leaving it messy is not an option. That instinct is behind most of the work I am known for.  A leading US airline was releasing monthly, painfully. We rebuilt their release engineering and quality model. They ship multiple times every week now, calmly. A US SaaS company needed offshore engineering that could run without hand-holding; we built it from zero to fully autonomous in six months. My operating belief: when something breaks repeatedly, it is almost never a people problem. It is a process problem wearing a person's face. Fix the process and the same "underperforming" team quietly becomes your best one. I have seen this too many times to count. These days the mess I find most interesting is engineering metrics that measure nothing, quality maturity models on paper only, and AI tooling bolted on without changing how teams actually work.

basic_profile.name: Vijay Bandarupalli
basic_profile.headline: Vice President & Regional Head, US West at ValueLabs | Scaling Engineering Organizations | AI & Cloud-Led Modernization
basic_profile.current_title: Vice President & Regional Head, US West
basic_profile.summary: Vice President and Regional Head at ValueLabs. I lead our US West regional business: a portfolio of SaaS, healthtech, HCM, and enterprise software clients across North America.I came into this role from delivery and technology, not sales. That shapes how I work.A few things that orient me:The P&L is the discipline. Running a region forces every lever into focus: revenue growth, talent investment, delivery quality, account health. They have to compound together or none of them hold. I treat the P&L as the lens, not the goal.Client engagement is a partnership. My strongest relationships are measured in years. Founders, CXOs, and senior leadership who call when they're sketching the next horizon, not just when something is on fire. That kind of trust comes from a partnership mindset: being useful, transparent, and invested in their outcomes across many cycles. I don't sell. I solve, and the relationships compound from there.Transformation work, not transformation theater. AI and cloud are the loudest conversations in enterprise software right now, and a lot of the noise is performative. The work that actually moves the needle is quieter: rewiring engineering organizations to ship faster with AI, modernizing platforms without breaking the business, and helping leadership teams form a credible point of view on where to invest. That's where I spend most of my time.Technology leadership at the architecture level. Eighteen years in, I still sit in architecture reviews and still read code. Seniority changes what I'm looking for, not whether I'm looking. Currently sponsoring the cloud-first transformation for a Fortune 500 client whose work earned a CIO100 Award, alongside Globee-recognized platforms across the broader portfolio. Long-running partnerships with Microsoft, Databricks, Qlik, and Datadog keep the playbook current.People are the long game. Every account I've grown was built on engineers who stayed, grew, and led. Talent density compounds, and so does the cost of getting hiring and leadership development wrong. I take both seriously.I write occasionally on Medium about engineering leadership, AI adoption, scaling teams, and the parts of this work that don't fit on a slide: medium.com/@vijay.bandarupalli. If those topics interest you, it's the best read on how I actually think.Open to conversations with founders, CXOs, and senior leaders thinking about scale, AI, and building durable engineering organizations.

basic_profile.name: Arjun Rao
basic_profile.headline: Founder and Chairman, ValueLabs
basic_profile.summary:
Arjun is a first-generation entrepreneur who has built a unique company with an entirely different approach to business.

As the Founder and Chairman, Arjun focuses on shaping the long-term vision for ValueLabs – setting the tone for its evolution into a platform-led services company, anchored in Vertical AI Consulting and Agentic AI Services. He is rooted in the belief that one can attain perfection when driven by ‘character strength’. He leads by example when it comes to doing the right thing at all times. Inspiring everyone in the company to build trust with clients and colleagues alike. Bringing alive our OneCompany model of engagement. 

Arjun holds an MS degree from Cornell University, US, where he held the A.D. White Fellowship. He has a Bachelor’s degree from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Madras, where he graduated at the top of his class.

Ask him how ‘doing the right thing’ sits at the center of everything at ValueLabs.

Specialties: 
•	Set-up, nurture and scale a global debt-free business from the ground up
•	Establish, build and maintain long term, value-based relationships
