basic_profile.name: Sam Alva
basic_profile.headline: Chief Executive Officer
basic_profile.summary: Twenty years. One company. 7,000 people. The privilege of serving as CEO. But the number that matters most is not any of those. It is the one behind why we built this in the first place. ValueLabs was founded by Arjun on the belief that doing the right thing and building a great business are the same thing, not tradeoffs. In the mid-nineties, Arjun's mother ran a school offering computer education to kids. When a quarter of them could not afford it, the answer was simple: everyone gets it for free. To fund that, they opened the same space for professional courses after hours. When those students graduated, Arjun helped find them jobs. One of those calls led to someone in the Bay Area saying, why don't we send you some work. The first offshore project ran out of the same school. ValueLabs was not born from a business plan. It was born from doing the right thing, repeatedly. That is still the operating system here. Most companies do not have an AI problem. They have an implementation problem. The models exist. The tools exist. What is missing is someone who can make AI work inside real workflows and real organizations. We identified that gap early. When Anthropic and OpenAI eventually built their own consulting arms to help enterprises figure out implementation, they were confirming what we had already been doing. We became customer zero before asking anyone else to transform. We rebuilt how we work around AiDE, our proprietary agentic AI platform. Every one of our 7,000 employees uses it across delivery and business processes. Independent analysts have described us as a category of one — the only enterprise-native agentic AI platform. That is not a claim we made about ourselves. It is what happens when you spend 34 months building something rather than piloting it. The foundation has always been deep partnerships and accountability. What has evolved is our ability to own outcomes directly through Transformation as a Service. We are not selling effort. We are selling outcomes. Most of our client relationships span a decade or more. Some go back twenty-five years. I think that says something. If you are navigating a meaningful transformation and want a conversation with someone who has been in the trenches for two decades, I would enjoy connecting.

basic_profile.name: Harish Mehta
basic_profile.headline: When mavericks collaborate, industry thrives! Learn more in my bestselling book ‘The Maverick Effect’ | Founder & EC @OnwardTech | 1st Elected Chairman at NASSCOM | Institution Builder – Mission 100 Million Jobs
basic_profile.summary:
Mr. Harish Mehta is a key institution builder behind India’s IT industry. He co-founded NASSCOM in 1988, was its first elected Chairman, and later served as Convener of NASSCOM’s Chairman’s Council.

Mr. Mehta is the award-winning author of the 2022 national bestseller 'The Maverick Effect'. A case study on the power of self-regulation inspired by the book,  has been accepted at Harvard. Its message continues to reach more people through paperback, Gujarati, Hindi and Marathi editions, and on Audible. The IMC Chamber of Commerce and Industry has instituted the Maverick Effect Awards under its annual Digital Innovation Awards. Mr. Mehta shares these ideas globally, spanning industry associations, educational institutes, leadership forums, global MNCs and NGOs.

In 1999, he brought Silicon Valley’s The Indus Entrepreneurs (TiE) to India to promote innovation-driven entrepreneurship; today, TiE India has 29 chapters nationwide.

Mr. Mehta’s entrepreneurial journey is embodied by the Onward Group of Companies. He served as Deputy Chairman and Managing Director of Onward Novell (1992–2005), a 50:50 JV between Onward Group and Novell Inc. Under his guidance, Onward Technologies evolved into a global engineering and digital services organization. Earlier, he was among the chief architects of the Hinditron–Digital (DEC) JV in India (1987).

He is a founding member of Infinity Ventures Fund, India’s first corporatized venture fund, and helped promote the Indian Angel Network (IAN) in Mumbai. Under the aegis of the G20/S20 process, he contributed to a self-regulatory corporate governance framework tailored to startups.

Building on decades of institution and ecosystem building, Mr. Mehta is also helping anchor the Mission Hundred Million Jobs initiative, a national effort bringing together industry, government and civil society to place job creation at the centre of India’s growth story amid AI-driven disruption and opportunity. Since being announced in January 2026, the mission has signed a 5-year MoU with the Rajasthan Skill and Livelihoods Development Corporation (RSLDC) to support the creation of 3.5 lakh jobs across Rajasthan through demand-linked skilling, enterprise participation, and district-level execution.

He also served as a Director at the College of Engineering, Pune (COEP) from 2010 to 2015 and was recognized as a Distinguished Alumnus in 1995. professional_network.name: Harish Mehta
professional_network.headline: When mavericks collaborate, industry thrives! Learn more in my bestselling book ‘The Maverick Effect’ | Founder & EC @OnwardTech | 1st Elected Chairman at NASSCOM | Institution Builder – Mission 100 Million Jobs
professional_network.summary:
Mr. Harish Mehta is a key institution builder behind India’s IT industry. He co-founded NASSCOM in 1988, was its first elected Chairman, and later served as Convener of NASSCOM’s Chairman’s Council.

Mr. Mehta is the award-winning author of the 2022 national bestseller 'The Maverick Effect'. A case study on the power of self-regulation inspired by the book,  has been accepted at Harvard. Its message continues to reach more people through paperback, Gujarati, Hindi and Marathi editions, and on Audible. The IMC Chamber of Commerce and Industry has instituted the Maverick Effect Awards under its annual Digital Innovation Awards. Mr. Mehta shares these ideas globally, spanning industry associations, educational institutes, leadership forums, global MNCs and NGOs.

In 1999, he brought Silicon Valley’s The Indus Entrepreneurs (TiE) to India to promote innovation-driven entrepreneurship; today, TiE India has 29 chapters nationwide.

Mr. Mehta’s entrepreneurial journey is embodied by the Onward Group of Companies. He served as Deputy Chairman and Managing Director of Onward Novell (1992–2005), a 50:50 JV between Onward Group and Novell Inc. Under his guidance, Onward Technologies evolved into a global engineering and digital services organization. Earlier, he was among the chief architects of the Hinditron–Digital (DEC) JV in India (1987).

He is a founding member of Infinity Ventures Fund, India’s first corporatized venture fund, and helped promote the Indian Angel Network (IAN) in Mumbai. Under the aegis of the G20/S20 process, he contributed to a self-regulatory corporate governance framework tailored to startups.

Building on decades of institution and ecosystem building, Mr. Mehta is also helping anchor the Mission Hundred Million Jobs initiative, a national effort bringing together industry, government and civil society to place job creation at the centre of India’s growth story amid AI-driven disruption and opportunity. Since being announced in January 2026, the mission has signed a 5-year MoU with the Rajasthan Skill and Livelihoods Development Corporation (RSLDC) to support the creation of 3.5 lakh jobs across Rajasthan through demand-linked skilling, enterprise participation, and district-level execution.

He also served as a Director at the College of Engineering, Pune (COEP) from 2010 to 2015 and was recognized as a Distinguished Alumnus in 1995. He holds a bachelor’s in electrical engineering from COEP and a master’s in computer science from NYU Tandon School of Engineering (formerly Brooklyn Polytechnic Institute).

past.employer_linkedin_description: With more than 80+ manufacturing facilities and over 7,000 employees worldwide, Signode is a leading manufacturer of a broad spectrum of packaging consumables, tools, software and equipment that optimize end-of line packaging operations and protect products in transit. Signode brings this extensive product portfolio together under hundreds of trusted brands to offer complete transit packaging solutions to its customers.We produce strap, stretch and protective packaging. We also manufacture packaging tools and equipment that are used to apply the bulk packaging materials. These packaging products are used to contain, unitize, protect and secure goods during warehousing and shipmentOur products protect industrial and consumer goods during transit, storage and handling.While our brands are not household names to consumers, they certainly are well known to companies that need to transport goods via commercial trucks, railways, ocean ships or airfreight. In fact, our brands generate unparalleled brand recognition across geographies and end markets, making the company a go-to name for industrial packaging.We make bulk transportation of goods possible through use of:Stretch packaging - plastic film that is wrapped around the outside of boxes, pallets, raw materials and other goods.Protective packaging - paper and plastic-based pieces that are placed around and between goods to protect products during transportation.Strap packaging - plastic and steel straps that are wrapped around steel coils, the outside of boxes, pallets, raw materials and other goods.Tools and machines that are used to apply the strap and stretch packaging.

The Indian School of Business (ISB) evolved from the need for a world-class business school in Asia. Established in 2001, the ISB has successfully put India on the global map of management education by pioneering several new trends in research, promoting innovation and training and nurturing young leaders who not only have an understanding of the developing economies but the society at large. With two state-of-the-art campuses in Hyderabad and Mohali, ISB provides opportunities to engage with the best of global management practice and thinking. In 2008, ISB became the youngest institution to be ranked among the Top 20 Global B-schools by the Financial Times, London, and since then has been ranked consistently among the top B-schools globally. A proficient pool of research-oriented resident and visiting faculty from top management institutions worldwide provides the essential thrust to ISB’s research milieu. ISB’s strong research acumen has helped produce knowledge and competencies to benefit industry and society, not only in India but across Asia and the rest of the world. Around the world, the School is represented by its network of 17,200+ alumni from the PGP and AMP suites, PGP,PGPMAX, PGPpro, PGP MFAB, AMPBA, AMPH, AMPI, AMPOS, and AMPPP, and the 50,000+ alumni of its Executive Education programmes.Whether it is through innovations in curricula to reflect the shifting business landscape or stimulating experiences and learning outside the classroom, the ISB is committed to providing the best avenue for management education and research to meet the growing need to develop young leaders who can manage global challenges.For more information on the School, visit www.isb.edu Follow us:Twitter: www.twitter.com/ISbeduFacebook: https://www.facebook.com/ISBedu/YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/isbindiaInstagram: https://www.instagram.com/isbindia/Blog: https://blogs.isb.edu/

Formed in 1975 at the request of the U.S. and Indian governments, the U.S.-India Business Council is the premier business advocacy organization in the U.S.-India corridor, composed of more than 200 top-tier U.S. and Indian companies advancing U.S.-India commercial ties. The Council aims to create an inclusive bilateral trade environment between India and the United States by serving as the voice of industry, linking governments to businesses, and supporting long-term commercial partnerships that will nurture the spirit of entrepreneurship, create jobs, and successfully contribute to the global economy.

Technology is transforming work in just about every sector of the global economy—and while these advances have created unparalleled opportunities for many, far too few have access to the quality education, training and job opportunities required to improve their economic and social mobility in a changing landscape.The Cognizant Foundation addresses this need to ensure all communities are prepared for the jobs driving the future, and to date has awarded approximately $60 million to more than 70 organizations working to deliver industry-relevant education, technical skills training programs and critical research needed to modernize the ways we educate and employ our workforce.We believe the tech industry can serve as an engine to unlock economic opportunity and expand equity in communities around the world. But that won’t happen unless we rethink the existing pipelines into the sector and the pathways through it—that’s why our work focuses so heavily on supporting historically excluded and underrepresented populations. The Cognizant Foundation currently invests in organizations based in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia and Germany.

past.employee_title: Programme Director & Global Head of Marketing & Sales
past.employee_description:
Sandeep was responsible for the development for CBC’s business in India and 52 other countries in the Commonwealth. He joined CBC as their first employee in 1999 and has been a core member to the board reporting to the CEO in the UK since then.

Sandeep has exposed organizations to investment projects, M&A deals and JV opportunities and has assisted them in bagging projects from Governments and Private sector in over 12 Commonwealth countries.

Sandeep has handled teams related to sales, lead generation and raising revenues from corporates.   

He has acquired in depth knowledge on Africa and has a contact base of over 12,000 in 32 countries, this includes CEO’s and senior Government officials. 

Sandeep is highly proficient in the African market. Traveled extensively in Asia (India, Singapore, Malaysia), Europe and Africa and has lived and worked in the UK for over 6 years before shifting base to India 3 years ago.

2.	Administration, Production & Co-ordination with Customers

Responsibilities:
1. Setting up (from scratch) 2 factories of 285 machines spread over an area of over 30,000 square feet (in a village in Gujarat, India). 
2. Heading the Marketing department in order to secure further overseas orders for the new factories.

current.employer_linkedin_description: The United States Senate Select Committee on Intelligence is dedicated to overseeing the United States Intelligence Community—the agencies and bureaus of the federal government of the United States who provide information and analysis for leaders of the executive and legislative branches. As part of its oversight responsibilities, the Committee performs an annual review of the intelligence budget submitted by the President and prepares legislation authorizing appropriations for the various civilian and military agencies and departments comprising the intelligence community. These entities include the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, Central Intelligence Agency, Defense Intelligence Agency, National Security Agency, National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency, National Reconnaissance Office, as well as the intelligence-related components of Department of State, Federal Bureau of Investigation, Department of the Treasury, and Department of Energy. The Committee makes recommendations to the Senate Armed Services Committee on authorizations for the intelligence-related components of the U.S. Army, U.S. Navy, U.S. Air Force, and U.S. Marine Corps. The Committee also conducts periodic investigations, audits, and inspections of intelligence activities and programs.

current.employer_linkedin_description: NED University of Engineering & Technology, formerly called the NED Government Engineering College, was established in March 1977 through an act of the Provincial Assembly of Sindh, Pakistan. NED Government Engineering College was set up in 1922 and therefore, it is one of the oldest engineering degree-awarding institutions in Pakistan.At the time of its inception, the institution was called the Prince of Wales Engineering College. Later, it was renamed in honor of Mr. Nadirshaw Edulji Dinshaw, who donated a large amount for the construction of the original buildings and laboratories of the engineering college.  NED College was initially affiliated with the University of Bombay. After the creation of Pakistan in 1947, it was taken over by the Government of Sindh, renamed as NED Government Engineering College, and affiliated to the University of Sindh. Once the University of Karachi was established in 1951, the affiliation of NED College was transferred to it. In 1964, NED College was shifted from its initial location in downtown (City Campus) to the current location on University Road (Main Campus), adjacent to the University of Karachi. Finally, on March 1, 1977, NED Government Engineering College was upgraded to the present NED University of Engineering & Technology.Today, NED University stands as the guiding beacon of light for the technological transformation of Pakistan into a new era of development and prosperity. Thousands of alumni from the university are serving in engineering and management of major industrial corporations in Pakistan, the Middle East, and beyond. The university administration is actively working to enhance the services and facilities offered to its students and alumni while redefining itself to focus on the technological innovations and engineering services most required by the local industry.

basic_profile.name: Harish Mehta
basic_profile.headline: When mavericks collaborate, industry thrives! Learn more in my bestselling book ‘The Maverick Effect’ | Founder & EC @OnwardTech | 1st Elected Chairman at NASSCOM | Institution Builder – Mission 100 Million Jobs
basic_profile.summary:
Mr. Harish Mehta is a key institution builder behind India’s IT industry. He co-founded NASSCOM in 1988, was its first elected Chairman, and later served as Convener of NASSCOM’s Chairman’s Council.

Mr. Mehta is the award-winning author of the 2022 national bestseller 'The Maverick Effect'. A case study on the power of self-regulation inspired by the book,  has been accepted at Harvard. Its message continues to reach more people through paperback, Gujarati, Hindi and Marathi editions, and on Audible. The IMC Chamber of Commerce and Industry has instituted the Maverick Effect Awards under its annual Digital Innovation Awards. Mr. Mehta shares these ideas globally, spanning industry associations, educational institutes, leadership forums, global MNCs and NGOs.

In 1999, he brought Silicon Valley’s The Indus Entrepreneurs (TiE) to India to promote innovation-driven entrepreneurship; today, TiE India has 29 chapters nationwide.

Mr. Mehta’s entrepreneurial journey is embodied by the Onward Group of Companies. He served as Deputy Chairman and Managing Director of Onward Novell (1992–2005), a 50:50 JV between Onward Group and Novell Inc. Under his guidance, Onward Technologies evolved into a global engineering and digital services organization. Earlier, he was among the chief architects of the Hinditron–Digital (DEC) JV in India (1987).

He is a founding member of Infinity Ventures Fund, India’s first corporatized venture fund, and helped promote the Indian Angel Network (IAN) in Mumbai. Under the aegis of the G20/S20 process, he contributed to a self-regulatory corporate governance framework tailored to startups.

Building on decades of institution and ecosystem building, Mr. Mehta is also helping anchor the Mission Hundred Million Jobs initiative, a national effort bringing together industry, government and civil society to place job creation at the centre of India’s growth story amid AI-driven disruption and opportunity. Since being announced in January 2026, the mission has signed a 5-year MoU with the Rajasthan Skill and Livelihoods Development Corporation (RSLDC) to support the creation of 3.5 lakh jobs across Rajasthan through demand-linked skilling, enterprise participation, and district-level execution.

He also served as a Director at the College of Engineering, Pune (COEP) from 2010 to 2015 and was recognized as a Distinguished Alumnus in 1995. He holds a bachelor’s in electrical engineering from COEP and a master’s in computer science from NYU Tandon School of Engineering (formerly Brooklyn Polytechnic Institute).

past.employer_linkedin_description: Set up on April 2, 1990 under an Act of Indian Parliament as a principal financial institution for:-- Promotion -- Financing and-- Development of industries in the MSME sector and -- Co-ordinating the functions of other institutions engaged in similar activities.Provision and Charter:SIDBI was established on April 2, 1990. The Charter establishing it, The Small Industries Development Bank of India Act, 1989 envisaged SIDBI to be "the principal financial institution for the promotion, financing and development of industry in the small-scale sector and to co-ordinate the functions of the institutions engaged in the promotion, financing or developing industry in the small-scale sector and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto".Business Domain of SIDBI:The business domain of SIDBI consists of small-scale industrial units, which contributes significantly to the national economy in terms of production, employment and exports. Business Strategy of SIDBI:The business strategy of SIDBI is to address the financial and non-financial gaps in the MSME ecosystem. Financial support to MSMEs is provided by way of (a) indirect finance / refinance to banks / financial institutions for onward lending to MSMEs and (b) direct finance in the niche areas like risk capital, sustainable finance, receivable financing, service sector financing, etc.

In 1964, NED College was shifted from its initial location in downtown (City Campus) to the current location on University Road (Main Campus), adjacent to the University of Karachi. BJP) is today the most prominent member of the family of organisations known as the "Sangh Parivar" and nurtured by the Rashtria Swyamsevak Sangh (RSS). Like the RSS, the BJP is wedded to India’s unity and integrity, its intrinsic identity and the social strength, individual character and cultural uniqueness that have been the hallmark of this great country and its people for millennia.History is the philosophy of nations. And the Sangh Parivar has a very clear and clear conception of Indian history. Here was a great civilization whose influence and imprint spread from Sri Lanka to Tibet, from Southeast Asia to Central Asia, from one end of the Indian Ocean to the other. It weathered the storms of invaders, from the Greeks to the Huns, from the Shakas to the Islamic armies of Turks and Afghans. It fought and resisted external oppression and its essential civilization and culture survived great challenges and attempts at effacement. The glory of Vijayanagara and the heroism of Maharana Pratap, of a Shivaji and of a Guru Govind Singh are testimony to the Indian spirit.In more recent times this torch of nationalism and Indian identity was carried forward by Swami Dayanand and Swami Vivekanada. And in the present century the good work has been carried on by Sri Aurobindo, Lokmanya Tilak, Mahatma Gandhi and others. The RSS, founded by Dr K.B. Hedgewar in 1925 and consolidated by Shri Guruji M.S. Golwalkar after 1940, sees itself as the legatee of this heroic tradition. It believes in the principle of: "Justice for all and appeasement of none". It has no doubt about Hindu identity and culture being the mainstay of the Indian nation and of Indian society. This identity and this culture informs all Indians, irrespective of religious or denominational faith. To the RSS, all Indians, irrespective of religious background, notwithstanding their mode and place of worship, are equal.

The U.S. Department of State is focused on accomplishing America's mission of diplomacy at home and around the world. The Department's employees carry out the President’s foreign policy with a focus on America's interests.U.S. Department of State employees, with their skills, character and commitment to public service, are the backbone of America's diplomacy. They represent the people and advocate the interests of the United States to the rest of the world.The Foreign Service is dedicated to representing America and responding to the needs of American citizens in other countries. Members of the Foreign Service represent America at embassies, consulates, and other diplomatic missions around the world. Civil Service employees provide in-depth expertise and continuity in accomplishing all aspects of the Department's mission and are involved in virtually every function of the Department. Civil Service employees issue passports, compile and analyze overseas reports, provide logistical support to posts, consult with Congress about foreign policy initiatives and policies, and formulate and manage the budget. Foreign Service National employees also supplement the personnel requirements of the Department overseas. FSN employees are local residents of the countries in which we maintain diplomatic posts and consulates. They are valued members of our embassy teams, for they provide continuity and have language and cultural expertise.

basic_profile.name: Sahil Jain
basic_profile.headline:
Co-Founder & CEO @ TMTC | Built & Scaled Dineout (Acquired by Swiggy) | 
Reimagining Global Healthcare Access with Systems Thinking
basic_profile.summary:
In 2012, I co-founded Dineout with three close friends, scaling from zero to India’s largest dining out platform, serving over 3 million diners every month across 17 cities. At Dineout, I led our push into B2B tech, acquiring and scaling SaaS products (inResto and Torqus) that now drive over 7,000+ restaurants worldwide. Dineout was acquired by Swiggy in 2022. 

Today, as Founder of TMTC (The Medical Travel Company), I’m focused on reimagining medical tourism at a global scale. Healthcare is one of the world’s most urgent, fragmented challenges - and I believe India will lead the change with quality, transparency, and technology-driven solutions. 

The Medical Travel Company is not a booking platform - but a systems solution for global healthcare access. We’re building ethical infrastructure that connects international patients to India’s top hospitals, with verified patient care pathways, transparent pricing, and end-to-end coordination.

My approach is simple: build with empathy, lead with integrity, and create enduring impact. I believe lasting companies are those that serve humanity - not just markets. If you’re a builder, investor, or passionate about transforming healthcare, let’s connect.

basic_profile.name: Ankit Mehrotra, CFA
basic_profile.headline: Co-Founder @ The Medical Travel Company (TMTC) | Co-founder @ Dineout  (Acquired by Swiggy) Angel Investor | Mentor | TEDx Speaker | Healthcare & Tech Entrepreneur
basic_profile.summary: A serial entrepreneur, TEDx speaker, and CFA charter holder, I’ve spent the last decade building disruptive platforms across industries from dining to now healthcare with The Medical Travel Company.Currently the Co-founder of TMTC the world’s first Full Stack Healthcare Concierge enabling end-to-end medical travel. Our mission is simple and bold: to make cross-border healthcare safe, trusted, and accessible. We partner with leading hospitals, governments, and wellness centers to transform medical tourism in India and beyond and bring world-class care closer to patients everywhere. This isn’t just healthcare, but healthcare innovation without borders.Previously, I co-founded and scaled Dineout, India’s largest dining out and restaurant tech platform. It started as a scrappy startup founder’s dream in 2012 and went onto become a market leader acquired by Swiggy in 2022. Along the way, I learned how to build trust at scale, disrupt traditional industries, and create platforms that outlive the founders who are behind them.Before entrepreneurship, I spent 10 years in London and worked with BNP Paribas (Investment Banking and Wealth Management) and also earned my CFA charter in 2011. That foundation definitely taught me systems, scale, and resilience but my heart has always been in building and creating.Beyond my ventures, I also actively invest in and mentor early-stage startups across EV, F&B, healthcare tech, sports tech, mental health, and more backing people and ideas that dare to be different. From finance to food to healthcare entrepreneurship, my journey has always been about creating access, rewriting rules, and also always proving that the underdog can win.At TMTC, we’re not just changing how the world heals. We’re changing how the world thinks about possibility.

basic_profile.summary:
As Head of Human Resources and Patient Ops at The Medical Travel Company (TMTC), I lead two core areas that shape who we are — our people and our patients.

basic_profile.name: Sahil Jain
basic_profile.headline:
Co-Founder & CEO @ TMTC | Built & Scaled Dineout (Acquired by Swiggy) | 
Reimagining Global Healthcare Access with Systems Thinking
basic_profile.summary:
In 2012, I co-founded Dineout with three close friends, scaling from zero to India’s largest dining out platform, serving over 3 million diners every month across 17 cities. At Dineout, I led our push into B2B tech, acquiring and scaling SaaS products (inResto and Torqus) that now drive over 7,000+ restaurants worldwide. Dineout was acquired by Swiggy in 2022. 

Today, as Founder of TMTC (The Medical Travel Company), I’m focused on reimagining medical tourism at a global scale. Healthcare is one of the world’s most urgent, fragmented challenges - and I believe India will lead the change with quality, transparency, and technology-driven solutions. 

The Medical Travel Company is not a booking platform - but a systems solution for global healthcare access. We’re building ethical infrastructure that connects international patients to India’s top hospitals, with verified patient care pathways, transparent pricing, and end-to-end coordination.

My approach is simple: build with empathy, lead with integrity, and create enduring impact. I believe lasting companies are those that serve humanity - not just markets. If you’re a builder, investor, or passionate about transforming healthcare, let’s connect.

basic_profile.summary: A serial entrepreneur, TEDx speaker, and CFA charter holder, I’ve spent the last decade building disruptive platforms across industries from dining to now healthcare with The Medical Travel Company.Currently the Co-founder of TMTC the world’s first Full Stack Healthcare Concierge enabling end-to-end medical travel. Our mission is simple and bold: to make cross-border healthcare safe, trusted, and accessible. We partner with leading hospitals, governments, and wellness centers to transform medical tourism in India and beyond and bring world-class care closer to patients everywhere. This isn’t just healthcare, but healthcare innovation without borders.Previously, I co-founded and scaled Dineout, India’s largest dining out and restaurant tech platform. It started as a scrappy startup founder’s dream in 2012 and went onto become a market leader acquired by Swiggy in 2022. Along the way, I learned how to build trust at scale, disrupt traditional industries, and create platforms that outlive the founders who are behind them.Before entrepreneurship, I spent 10 years in London and worked with BNP Paribas (Investment Banking and Wealth Management) and also earned my CFA charter in 2011. That foundation definitely taught me systems, scale, and resilience but my heart has always been in building and creating.Beyond my ventures, I also actively invest in and mentor early-stage startups across EV, F&B, healthcare tech, sports tech, mental health, and more backing people and ideas that dare to be different. From finance to food to healthcare entrepreneurship, my journey has always been about creating access, rewriting rules, and also always proving that the underdog can win.At TMTC, we’re not just changing how the world heals. We’re changing how the world thinks about possibility.

basic_profile.name: Sahil Jain
basic_profile.headline:
Co-Founder & CEO @ TMTC | Built & Scaled Dineout (Acquired by Swiggy) | 
Reimagining Global Healthcare Access with Systems Thinking
basic_profile.summary:
In 2012, I co-founded Dineout with three close friends, scaling from zero to India’s largest dining out platform, serving over 3 million diners every month across 17 cities. At Dineout, I led our push into B2B tech, acquiring and scaling SaaS products (inResto and Torqus) that now drive over 7,000+ restaurants worldwide. Dineout was acquired by Swiggy in 2022. 

Today, as Founder of TMTC (The Medical Travel Company), I’m focused on reimagining medical tourism at a global scale. Healthcare is one of the world’s most urgent, fragmented challenges - and I believe India will lead the change with quality, transparency, and technology-driven solutions. 

The Medical Travel Company is not a booking platform - but a systems solution for global healthcare access. We’re building ethical infrastructure that connects international patients to India’s top hospitals, with verified patient care pathways, transparent pricing, and end-to-end coordination.

My approach is simple: build with empathy, lead with integrity, and create enduring impact. I believe lasting companies are those that serve humanity - not just markets. If you’re a builder, investor, or passionate about transforming healthcare, let’s connect.

basic_profile.name: Khushboo Aggarwal
basic_profile.headline: Founder at Zyla Health - Building India’s first care management platform focused on outcomes.
basic_profile.summary:
At Zyla Health, we are driven by a sincere purpose to improve health outcomes for millions of people around the world, saving the next hospitalization. This journey started in 2017 inspired by my own family events of untimely health complications brought on by chronic diseases. Since then, I have dedicated my life to the cause of patient-centric healthcare with focus on identifying the risky population and ensuring timely interventions to prevent complications.

We are trusted by and deliver health outcomes for large Pharma MNCs such as AstraZeneca, Pfizer, Novartis, Zydus, as well as large insurers such as Max Life, Aditya Birla Health Insurance, Care Insurance. Over the last few years, we have been able to apply the same vision for employee wellness where the offering just doesn’t stop with transactional services, rather a value added journey which improves employee health at every step. We offer best-in-class health and wellness leveraging our 3-step approach to large enterprises (a) assessment, (b) risk analysis and (c) personalized care, ensuring healthcare outcomes and tangible ROI for the business. 

Prior to Zyla, I have spent time at Deloitte and Monitor in healthcare consulting, primarily in the value-based care and digital health space in the US. I am an MBA from IIM Kozhikode and pursued Pharmacy (Hons.) from BITS Pilani, and been operating in the healthcare space since the very beginning.

At Zyla Health, our team shares a common goal: to create a healthcare system that treats individuals with compassion and delivers outcomes. We are dedicated to ensuring that everyone has access to the care they need, when they need it. We are always looking for purpose driven people to join our mission, DM if the purpose resonates with you and we can chat.

current.employee_description:
Next-generation Medical AI to treat chronic conditions.

Zyla has developed a personalized chatbot powered by a deep learning-enabled “medical brain”, that analyzes millions of data points across the patient history in real-time to deliver the most accurate medical interventions across medications, symptoms, diagnostics, nutrition and exercise.

Today, in India alone, more than 250 million people are suffering from chronic diseases (such as diabetes and heart disease). These people are currently at the mercy of a very unstructured healthcare system with no one to take ownership of their health. This results in a poor quality of life, increasing diseases and complications, and recurring hospitalisations. Zyla is one-of-its-kind healthcare technology solution completely focused on patient outcomes.

Zyla provides subscription-based, virtual health management personalised for each individual, with continuous monitoring on the Zyla mobile application. It involves a wide range of interventions from observing small habits to recommending necessary medical interventions. At the heart of this care delivery, lies a "medical brain" built using 50,000+ medical protocols, NLP, Machine Learning, and AI, which flags timely interventions, delivers first level of intelligent & real-time responses to patients, and helps medical practitioners deliver data-driven care which is practically non-existent today. Zyla envisages to be the healthcare assistant for millions of families across the globe!

With exemplary patient outcomes and program renewal rates of 80%+, Zyla is on course to build a world-class and scalable product which creates a long- lasting impact on humanity, in this case, saving lives! If you are passionate about building one, let's get in touch!

past.employer_linkedin_description: OYO is a global platform that aims to empower entrepreneurs and small businesses with hotels and homes by providing full-stack technology products and services that aims to increase revenue and ease operations; bringing easy-to-book, affordable, and trusted accommodation to customers around the world. OYO offers 40+ integrated products and solutions to patrons who operate over 157K hotel and home storefronts in more than 35 countries including India, Europe, and Southeast Asia.OYO was founded by 27-year-old Ritesh Agarwal, the first Asian resident to be accepted to the Thiel Fellowship (started by Paypal founder Peter Thiel).OYO operates a unique business model that helps its patrons transform fragmented, unbranded and underutilized hospitality assets into branded, digitally-enabled storefronts with higher revenue generation potential and provides its customers with access to a broad range of high-quality storefronts at compelling price points. OYO customers can book storefronts through OYO’s own D2C channels and through indirect channels with third-party OTAs. The OYO App offers a variety of digital tools to guide customers throughout their journey, including discovery, seamless booking, pre-stay assistance, cancellations, digital check-ins as well as in-stay and post-stay services. With over 100 mn downloads, the OYO App was the 3rd most downloaded travel app in 2020. OYO Wizard, OYO’s loyalty program, has 9.2 million members and is the second largest loyalty program run by a travel or food brand in India, by subscriber base.

basic_profile.name: Khushboo Aggarwal
basic_profile.headline: Founder at Zyla Health - Building India’s first care management platform focused on outcomes.
basic_profile.summary:
At Zyla Health, we are driven by a sincere purpose to improve health outcomes for millions of people around the world, saving the next hospitalization. This journey started in 2017 inspired by my own family events of untimely health complications brought on by chronic diseases. Since then, I have dedicated my life to the cause of patient-centric healthcare with focus on identifying the risky population and ensuring timely interventions to prevent complications.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Birla Institute of Technology & Science (BITS), Pilani is a prestigious Indian university for higher education in science, technology and humanities. BITS Pilani has consistently ranked amongst the top universities in India. The acceptance rate of BITS Pilani is 1.47% making it the most selective university in India.The primary motive of BITS is to "train young men and women able and eager to create and put into action such ideas, methods, techniques and information". The Institute is a dream come true of its founder late Mr G.D.Birla - an eminent industrialist, a participant in Indian freedom struggle and a close associate of the Father of Indian Nation late Mr. Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi (Mahatma Gandhi). What started in early 1900s as a small school, blossomed into a set of colleges for higher education, ranging from the Humanities to Engineering until 1964 when all these colleges amalgamated to culminate into a unique Indian University of International standing. This university was christened as the Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani, known to many as BITS, Pilani.Over the years, BITS has provided the highest quality technical education to students from all over India admitted on the basis of merit. Its graduates may be found throughout the world in all areas of engineering, science and commerce. BITS symbolizes the maturing of Indian technical ability and "can-do" entrepreneurial spirit, especially as derived from the private sector. BITS is located in the Vidya Vihar campus adjacent to the town of Pilani in Rajasthan.Admission is merit-based, as assessed by the online BITSAT examination. The fully residential institute is privately supported.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Enterprises write every process twice. Once as intent, in documents, spreadsheets and meeting notes. Again as configuration, rebuilt by hand across the systems that will actually run it. The gap between those two versions is where quarters disappear.Manch closes that gap with Agentic AI.Describe. Build. Test. Deploy. Operate. Tell the agent what the process should do, and it assembles the fields, workflows, approvals, roles, business rules and exceptions that make the process real. It tests the result, moves it into production on your platform, and carries what it learned into the next deployment. Manch Intelligence compounds that knowledge, so every process starts further ahead than the one before it.The foundation underneath is not new. Manch has run enterprise process orchestration, master data management, governance and integrations for years. Agentic AI operates on that groundwork, which means it configures against data and rules the enterprise already trusts. Governance sits inside the design, not bolted on afterwards.Manch is not a general-purpose agent builder, and it does not hand the process over to the machine. People approve the requirement, review the configuration, sign off the deployment and audit the operation. The agent does the implementation work. The decisions stay with your team.Manch's approach to AI in product innovation, turning business intent into production-ready processes in hours rather than months, earned the 2026 Times of India AI Quotient Award for AI in Product Innovation.

basic_profile.summary: Built sovereign AI businesses. Closed government and enterprise deals. Scaled revenue in regulated, high-stakes environments.15+ years at the intersection of sales, ownership, and AI-driven transformation, not designing strategies from a distance, but taking them to market, winning flagship accounts, and making the numbers move. Scaled ventures from zero to ₹5.7Cr+ in year one. Now leading CoRover’s Government Business Unit, securing multi-year AI/ML contracts with MeitY–NeGD (₹4Cr/year for 3 years), signing and closing BFSI mandates (e.g., SberBank) within weeks, and forging strategic alliances (Tech Mahindra, global universities, Middle East partners) to deploy safe, sovereign AI at scale.My belief about great sales hasn’t changed, deep customer understanding, sharp storytelling, and relentless consistency, remove any one leg and the whole thing collapses. That turns out to be the best training there is and exactly what it takes to make sovereign AI a core pillar of India’s and the world’s digital government stack.

past.employer_linkedin_description: HCC is a business group of global scale, developing and building responsible infrastructure through next practices. HCC has a history that dates to the 1920’s, when pioneering industrialist Seth Walchand Hirachand had constructed the Borghat Railway Tunnel on the Bombay – Poona railway line. Incidentally, the Borghat Tunnel continues to serve this rail route even today. Subsequently, in 1926, Seth Walchand founded the Hindustan Construction Company. Over the years, HCC has built many of modern India's most challenging infrastructure projects: including the Bandra Worli Sea Link; the hill city of Lavasa; the Mumbai - Pune Expressway, India's largest nuclear power plant at Kudankulam, Tamil Nadu and high-altitude hydel power projects in the Himalayas. HCC today has a knowledge asset of over 3,000 officers, including around 1,600 engineers. It employs around 25,000 workers at its project sites across India. The HCC Group of companies comprises of HCC Ltd., HCC Real Estate Ltd, Lavasa Corporation Ltd., HCC Infrastructure Co. Ltd., and Steiner AG. Committed to deliver 'Responsible Infrastructure', HCC executes initiatives in Water Sustainability, Disaster Relief and Response, HIV/AIDS Awareness, Community Development and Education. HCC was adjudged for Best Social Investment Strategy by the World CSR Congress in February 2013 and also accorded the ‘Civic Award for Social Development’ by the Bombay Chamber of Commerce and Industry in June 2013.

The acceptance rate of BITS Pilani is 1.47% making it the most selective university in India.The primary motive of BITS is to "train young men and women able and eager to create and put into action such ideas, methods, techniques and information". The Institute is a dream come true of its founder late Mr G.D.Birla - an eminent industrialist, a participant in Indian freedom struggle and a close associate of the Father of Indian Nation late Mr. Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi (Mahatma Gandhi). What started in early 1900s as a small school, blossomed into a set of colleges for higher education, ranging from the Humanities to Engineering until 1964 when all these colleges amalgamated to culminate into a unique Indian University of International standing. This university was christened as the Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani, known to many as BITS, Pilani.Over the years, BITS has provided the highest quality technical education to students from all over India admitted on the basis of merit. Its graduates may be found throughout the world in all areas of engineering, science and commerce. BITS symbolizes the maturing of Indian technical ability and "can-do" entrepreneurial spirit, especially as derived from the private sector. BITS is located in the Vidya Vihar campus adjacent to the town of Pilani in Rajasthan.Admission is merit-based, as assessed by the online BITSAT examination. The fully residential institute is privately supported.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Election Commission of India (ECI) is a permanent Constitutional Authority. The Election Commission was established in accordance with the Constitution on 25th January 1950, a day before India became Republic. The Election Commission of India is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering Union and State election processes in India. As per Article 324 of the Constitution, ECI administers elections to the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, State Legislative Assemblies in India, and the offices of the President and Vice President in the country.ECI is a three member body comprising one Chief Election Commissioner and two Election Commissioners. Currently, Shri Gyanesh Kumar is the Chief Election Commissioner of India and Dr. Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Dr. Vivek Joshi are the Election Commissioners.

past.employer_linkedin_description: EDS was started in 1962 by H. Ross Perot.[1] Perot’s goal was to establish a company that offered high-end electronic data processing management personnel, along with the computer hardware, by targeting large corporations and by offering long-term contracts at a time when short-term contracts were the industry norm. The creation of Medicare in 1965 gave EDS an opportunity to enter government contracting, and by 1968 Medicare and Medicaid contracts provided about 25 percent of EDS revenues. By 1977, healthcare-claims processing accounted for nearly 40 percent of EDS revenues. In 1984, General Motors agreed to buy EDS for $2.5 billion. In 1996, GM spun off EDS again as an independent company, and then became one of its largest clients. On May 13, 2008, Hewlett-Packard Co. confirmed that it had reached a deal with Electronic Data Systems to acquire the company for $13.9 billion.[2] The deal was completed on August 26, 2008. EDS became an HP business unit and was temporarily renamed "EDS, an HP company". Ronald A. Rittenmeyer, EDS Chairman, President, and CEO, remained at the helm and reported to HP CEO Mark Hurd until his retirement.[3] As of 2008, EDS employed 139,000 people in 64 countries, the largest locations being the United States, India and the UK. It was ranked as one of the largest service companies on the Fortune 500 list with around 2,000 clients.

basic_profile.name: Prakash Arunachalam
basic_profile.headline: Chief Operating Officer | Board Member
basic_profile.summary: Prakash is a seasoned IT industry veteran with an impressive 32 years of  career marked by significant accomplishments in Digital CX Solutions, Automation, and AI, particularly in the Banking & Financial Services as well as Healthcare sectors. He has led a large business of over $200mn with over 2500 team members globally. Currently as President & COO of Servion, his journey with Servion stared in 2017 as CIO back then when the company was owned by Everstone Capital a Singapore based Private Equity firm which eventually was bought by EMK Capital in 2023. Having the trust of both the outgoing PE as well as the incoming PE who retained Prakash on his COO role is a testimony of Prakash’s executive leadership skills. In this COO role, he leads Delivery, HR, IT, SQA and other enablement functions. Prakash was instrumental in achieving remarkable outcomes: a 50% revenue growth and an astounding 200% increase in EBITDA in just two years to maximize the value of Servion's Services business. Recognizing his unwavering excellence and executive skills, Everstone Capital promoted Prakash to the role of President & COO in 2020. He played a pivotal role in strategically separating Servion's Services and product businesses, subsequently unlocking the Product business's inherent value through a successful sale to another Private Equity firm in 2022, post that he led the M&A deal with the bankers and prospective investors, ultimately resulting in the sale of the Services Business in 2023 to Private Equity firm EMK Capital a London based Private Equity firm. Prakash strategically diversified Servion's partnerships, forging alliances with major CX industry players such as Microsoft, Google, AWS, Cisco, Genesys, Ring Central, Nice, Verint, and several AI-driven product companies offering Cloud-based Omni Channel Digital Solutions, Speech Analytics, Predictive Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics, and Automation solutions .Before his tenure at Servion, Prakash served as the Global Delivery Head for Banking & Financial Services at Virtusa, managing a substantial $200 million business and leading a global team of 2500+ professionals. Over 4.5 years at Virtusa, Prakash, in collaboration with the executive leadership team, was instrumental in driving the company's growth from $150 million to an impressive $1 billion, which included the strategic acquisition of Polaris. His illustrious career includes Sales leadership role at Polaris in UK for 4 years and Program management roles in EDS for 10 years.

past.employer_linkedin_description: EDS was started in 1962 by H. Ross Perot.[1] Perot’s goal was to establish a company that offered high-end electronic data processing management personnel, along with the computer hardware, by targeting large corporations and by offering long-term contracts at a time when short-term contracts were the industry norm. The creation of Medicare in 1965 gave EDS an opportunity to enter government contracting, and by 1968 Medicare and Medicaid contracts provided about 25 percent of EDS revenues. By 1977, healthcare-claims processing accounted for nearly 40 percent of EDS revenues. In 1984, General Motors agreed to buy EDS for $2.5 billion. In 1996, GM spun off EDS again as an independent company, and then became one of its largest clients. On May 13, 2008, Hewlett-Packard Co. confirmed that it had reached a deal with Electronic Data Systems to acquire the company for $13.9 billion.[2] The deal was completed on August 26, 2008. EDS became an HP business unit and was temporarily renamed "EDS, an HP company". Ronald A. Rittenmeyer, EDS Chairman, President, and CEO, remained at the helm and reported to HP CEO Mark Hurd until his retirement.[3] As of 2008, EDS employed 139,000 people in 64 countries, the largest locations being the United States, India and the UK. It was ranked as one of the largest service companies on the Fortune 500 list with around 2,000 clients.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Cambridge Technology Partners is a consulting firm that works with clients to deliver successful projects and facilitate positive change. This is why we openly share our methodology, deliver detailed documentation, and take on client employees as core project members to train and develop them.A little (convoluted) history:- 1991: Founded in Cambridge, MA- 1997: Japan subsidiary was founded- 1999: Reached peak revenue of $628M with 4,000 global employees- 2001: Novell acquired the global entity and subsequently folded most of it into Novell's e-services division- 2006: Japan subsidiary joined the Nihon Unisys group (now BIPROGY)- 2019: Cambridge Technology Partners Japan, as the only surviving bearer of the brand, reenters the US marketAlthough we have evolved over time and have adapted our service delivery for the Japan market, our core identity and DNA have been directly passed down from the Cambridge MA based consulting firm. We still follow the same RAD (Rapid Application Development) methodology and follow the same six values (Take Initiative, Dedication, Flexibility/Openness, Respect, Honesty, Trust) and guiding principles (Fast, Right, Open, Guaranteed, Business Case, Behavioral Focused). Cambridge Technology Partners is back. We may have evolved and our methodology may be more sophisticated, but we are still the same culture focused consulting firm obsessed with doing what is right for our clients.Cambridge is a wholly owned subsidiary of BIPROGY Inc. basic_profile.name: Anand Rao
basic_profile.headline: Partner | Architecting AI-First Enterprise Growth & Operating Models | Scaling Data Analytics, Responsible AI & Agentic Ecosystems | P&L | CAIDP Research Group Member, Safe AI London, CJBS, IE, Wharton | Lecturer
basic_profile.summary:
I help organisations move beyond AI pilots into becoming scalable, responsible, AI-native enterprises, where intelligence is embedded in every decision, process, and product, and where value creation is inseparable from sustainability.

Across two decades spanning engineering, venture, advisory, and enterprise leadership, I have supported organisations evolving from digital enablement to data-driven decisioning, and now to AI-first operating models. My work focuses on Advanced Analytics, Responsible AI, and Agentic AI ecosystems, designing growth and operating models shaped by circular economic principles so that intelligence and value reinforce and regenerate over time.

I have worked with leaders in Retail & CPG, Financial Services, Manufacturing, and Travel to translate Digital, Data & AI into scaled, enduring systems, anchored in the levers that drive meaningful outcomes: data supply chains, AI economics, orchestration governance, and organisational literacy. I collaborate with hyperscalers, research communities, and emerging technology ecosystems to unlock systemic, sustainable impact.

My perspective is informed by the convergence of human behaviour, cognition-aware system design, agentic architectures, and sustainable AI, ensuring progress remains responsible, regenerative, and genuinely useful. My differentiator is turning complexity into commercial clarity, quickly and across cultures, industries, and regulatory environments.

Outside the enterprise context, I mentor, contribute to Safe AI communities in London, and guest lecture at universities and global forums. I believe the next generation of organisations will not simply adopt AI, they will be designed around it, with trust, accountability, and human sense-making at the core.

If you are building towards that future, we should talk.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗜 𝗗𝗼
  • AI Agents & Workflow Automation: I design intelligent, event-driven AI systems that combine autonomous agents, LLMs, and workflow orchestration.
    • 𝘌𝘹𝘢𝘮𝘱𝘭𝘦𝘴:
             • 𝘊𝘳𝘦𝘸𝘈𝘐 𝘗𝘪𝘱𝘦𝘭𝘪𝘯𝘦𝘴: multi-agent collaboration for complex reasoning tasks.
             • 𝘯8𝘯 𝘐𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘨𝘳𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘴: low-code automation connecting LLMs with external APIs and databases.

  • 𝗟𝗟𝗠𝗢𝗽𝘀 & 𝗠𝗟𝗢𝗽𝘀 𝗮𝘁 𝗦𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗲: From 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 and 𝗺𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹 𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 to 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗻𝘂𝗼𝘂𝘀 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴/𝗱𝗲𝗽𝗹𝗼𝘆𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁, I build robust infrastructures that accelerate model lifecycle management.
    • 𝘌𝘹𝘢𝘮𝘱𝘭𝘦: 𝗟𝗟𝗠𝗢𝗽𝘀: best practices for prompt management, semantic caching, and CI/CD for LLM-driven applications.

  • 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱 & 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴: Deep hands-on experience with 𝗔𝘇𝘂𝗿𝗲, 𝗔𝗪𝗦, 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗚𝗖𝗣, leveraging containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), streaming (Kafka, EventHub), and big-data tools (Spark, PySpark, Hadoop).

𝗛𝗶𝗴𝗵𝗹𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁𝘀
  • 𝗙𝘂𝗹𝗹-𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗰𝗸 𝗠𝗟 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿: Strong foundation in algorithms, feature engineering, and distributed data processing with Python, R, Java, Scala, SQL/NoSQL.
  • 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗠𝗶𝗻𝗱𝘀𝗲𝘁: I write clean, maintainable code, automate workflows, and implement CI/CD pipelines that meet enterprise security and governance needs.
  • 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 & 𝗗𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆: Proven record leading cross-functional teams and delivering large-scale ML projects on time.

I’m passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI, exploring agentic workflows, and mentoring teams to adopt cutting-edge practices that translate directly into measurable business value.

basic_profile.name: Mackenna Dsouza
basic_profile.headline: Hands on : Senior Technology Management | Product Owner | Enterprise Architecture | Data Engineering | AI Engineering | Application Engineering | Internal Developer Platforms
basic_profile.current_title: Senior Director and Client Technology Partner
basic_profile.summary:
Mackenna's core expertise spans Data Engineering, Enterprise Architecture,  Project Management, Commodities Trading and Risk Management (North American Power, FTRs, and Gas Trading), and Quantitative Software development.

At Humana, Mackenna is building an Enterprise API Layer centered around REST, Async, GraphQL, Grpc, Web Sockets, and API Gateways, to abstract domain services and standardize internal and external integration across the company.  This effort allows for phased upgrade and digital transformation of individual legacy domain services without impacting other dependent systems, aiding Humana's transition from an insurance company to a health care provider.

At Crane Worldwide Logistics, Mackenna was focused on data engineering. Change Data Capture (CDC) from operational SAAS system databases, Microsoft Dynamics CRM / CDP, Accounting systems, and other source systems was implemented using HVR.  Data was incident on Snowflake staging tables.  A medallion architecture was implemented using DBT.  Power BI Report Server was used for reporting.  Reverse ETL was implemented using Hightouch. Integration was implemented using a Portal and APIs. Within a year, senior management, operations, and accounting now have significant visibility into operations allowing for the identification and exploitation of growth drivers across the company.

At Energiewerks Analytics and Shogi Consulting Services, Mackenna was focused on North American Gas, Power, and FTR trading in various capacities. Areas of concentration over several projects spanned trade capture, fundamental analysis, data engineering and analytics, derivative pricing, and Market Risk analytics ( P&L Attribution, VAR, Scenario Analysis, Stress testing, and What-if Analysis ).  Mackenna has significant experience in Physical and Financial Natural Gas, Power, and FTRs.  Analytics around retail power ( forecasting, DA / RT market integration across ISOs, Gross Margin reporting, C&I deal structuring ), natural gas storage and transportation modeling, Index, structured notes, and exotics valuation in the capacity of a quant.

Mackenna has contributed code to several startups in martech, logistics, retail energy providers, hedge funds, security, and open-source projects. Drawing on his electrical engineering background he has made contributions to three businesses in the renewables and distributed generation space.

basic_profile.name: Amol K.
basic_profile.headline: Revenue Executive | Revenue Forecasting, Margin Governance & Enablement Across IT Services, AI & Analytics | MBA Cornell | Scaled Coforge $600M→$1B | CEO Partnership
basic_profile.summary: Revenue is not a function. It is the operating thesis of the company, and most organizations do not have one.  That gap is where I have spent the last six years. Currently leading Revenue Operations at Tiger Analytics overseeing revenue and margin reporting and a 40% YoY growth trajectory. Built the first-ever 12-month revenue forecast framework where no model existed, creating scalable governance across CPG, Retail/CS, Life Sciences, and BFS segments.  Before Tiger, four-year arc at Coforge governing the $600M to $1B revenue journey through three roles of expanding scope. Chief of Staff to the CEO covering executive decision support, M&A coordination, and post-COVID business continuity when 28% of revenue flatlined from Travel vertical exposure. AVP Corporate Development directing revenue and margin reporting to the CEO across BFS, Travel, Insurance, CIMS, D&A, and Product Engineering segments. AVP Customer Success owning key account strategy responsible for $82M incremental revenue YoY. $20M to $70M M&A transactions spanning diligence through integration.  The 20-year foundation underneath the C-suite governance arc is what makes the work durable. Senior delivery and program leadership across Conduent, Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield, Guardian Life, JPMorgan Chase, EmblemHealth, and Merck across ERP modernizations, claims platforms, and large-budget technology programs. Cornell MBA. Certified Scrum Master.  My conviction on revenue leadership is simple. The organizations that scale durably are the ones with a leader who can build the forecast, govern the margin, partner with the CFO on capital allocation, lead diligence on the right inorganic moves, and translate revenue performance to the board with the same fluency. Doing all five at scale is what makes revenue an operating thesis rather than a function. The discipline is industry-portable: IT services, AI and analytics, SaaS, FinTech, healthcare technology, and any growth-stage enterprise where revenue governance is the difference between credible and aspirational.  I write occasionally on LinkedIn about revenue operations, forecasting governance, corporate development, and the discipline of running revenue as a strategic function. Always glad to connect with fellow revenue and corporate development leaders thinking about the same problems.

basic_profile.name: Sreejith Janardanan
basic_profile.headline: Global Head – Production Support | Agentic AI-Driven XOps & Managed Operations for Fortune 500 Clients | GCC Setup & Scaling
basic_profile.summary:
I’m a seasoned technology leader with 25+ years of experience driving global production support and managed operations for Fortune 500 clients. As Senior Director & Practice Head – Production Support at Tiger Analytics, I lead the transformation of traditional support into AI-driven, agentic XOps models, delivering intelligent, scalable, and outcome-based operations through a proprietary automation platform.

Previously at Epsilon India, I established the Global Production Operations Center in Bangalore, supporting 100+ accounts in digital marketing, CRM, and loyalty domains. I pioneered the shift to an ITIL-aligned, "as-a-service" delivery model, optimizing performance and cost efficiency for global clients.

I have also led and delivered multi-million-dollar production support programs at Infosys, Consona, and HP, working across both onshore and offshore locations—driving innovation, operational efficiency, and automation at scale.

My expertise spans DevOps, SRE, ITIL, ADM, and outcome-based support models. I’ve managed 24x7 application, infrastructure, and product support operations, and contributed to presales, delivery frameworks, and recruitment strategy.

I hold a Master’s in Computer Science (NIE Mysore) and an MBA in Operations (Symbiosis), with certifications in ITIL V3, COBIT, and MCSD ( .NET).

Rutgers Business School-Newark and New Brunswick is an integral part of one of the nation’s oldest, largest, and most distinguished institutions of higher learning: Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey. Founded in 1929, Rutgers Business School has been accredited since 1941 by AACSB International — the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business — a distinction that represents the hallmark of excellence in management education. Today, Rutgers Business School is educating more than 8,000 undergraduate and graduate students at two main campuses in New Jersey as well as six satellite locations in New Jersey, China, and Singapore. Steeped in academic excellence, with a distinguished faculty and a corps of over 36,000 successful alumni. Rutgers Business School connects two extraordinary universities: Rutgers University–Newark and Rutgers University–New Brunswick, with mutually reinforcing strategic priorities. At Rutgers University–Newark, we are leaders in business education keenly attuned to America’s and the world’s metropolitan future, including vibrant specialized graduate programs that impel growth and create social impact by our strong public, private, and community partnerships. At Rutgers University–New Brunswick, we play a key role in the big picture of the Rutgers system to prepare New Jersey’s talent and to attract future business leaders from emerging markets to our elite AAU campus which is part of the Big Ten, the nation’s preeminent academic and athletic conference. Together, we are the anchor business school of New Jersey and a force to be reckoned with in the national and global arenas.Rutgers Business School offers bachelor's, master's, and Ph.D. degrees including highly ranked Executive, Full-Time & Part-Time MBA programs, a 14-month MBA in Professional Accounting and masters degrees in Accounting, Quantitative Finance, Financial Analysis, Information Technology, Business of Fashion, Supply Chain Management and Healthcare.

I have managed global portfolios at Genpact, driven impactful growth at Flipkart, and built a category-disrupting startup in India. My expertise lies in integrating AI, Generative AI, and advanced analytics to deliver scalable, data-driven business solutions that enhance operational efficiency and profitability. I thrive at the intersection of technology and strategy, designing enduring operating models that align with business goals and enable sustainable growth.

Throughout my career, I have successfully managed multi-million-dollar portfolios, scaling innovative solutions and leading high-performing teams across multiple industries. I have a proven track record of optimizing processes, streamlining operations, and creating new revenue opportunities by fostering collaboration across executive leadership teams and navigating complex business challenges.

Some of my key achievements include:

* Portfolio Expansion at Genpact: Currently lead growth strategy for a $1B+ business segment and previously led a $200M global portfolio, achieving 25% growth by driving AI and digital transformation strategies.

* Industry-Leading Target Operating Model: Designed an award-winning operating model for a publicly-listed FMCG company, setting a new industry benchmark for transforming enterprise-shared services and core operations.

* Topline Growth at Flipkart: Led P&L for the Books and Media categories, achieving over 50% topline growth, expanding market share by 800+ basis points, and improving profitability by 700+ basis points within one year.

* AVAZ Product Launch: Developed and launched an award-winning communication device for individuals with disabilities, securing national recognition and funding for in-house product development.

* Strategic Business Model Transformation: Partnered with the CEO at ICUMI Technologies to pivot Dealivore.com from a consumer-facing group buying model to a corporate benefits program, expanding operations and successfully competing against well-funded rivals.

I am passionate about leveraging emerging technologies, fostering innovation, and driving strategic growth to help organizations achieve their business objectives. I enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to build scalable, AI-driven solutions that deliver measurable results and long-term value.

Let’s connect and explore how we can drive transformation and growth together.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Avaz Inc. is an app development company with a focus on communication and language learning.In 2010, we launched the Avaz AAC for iPad, which helps children and adults with complex communication needs due to conditions such as autism, communicate. Our AAC app is one of the industry leaders worldwide with regular sales in US school districts and across the world. In India, it is recommended by the government for special schools.Our founder, Ajit Narayanan won the National Award for the Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities in December 2010. He was also recognized as a global young leader by MIT Technology Review which rated Avaz as the Innovation of the Year 2011.In 2015, we invented the FreeSpeech method of communication, as demonstrated in the FreeSpeech app - a revolutionary way to construct language. Our founder spoke on the TED stage about FreeSpeech and its video on TED.com has been viewed over a million times. The FreeSpeech app was also featured by Apple. Ajit spoke at Apple WWDC 2016 about this invention.In 2017, we launched 虫虫吃单词 (ChongChongEatsWords) - an app that teaches English through picture books and storybooks to Chinese kids. Based on a bookworm called ChongChong (meaning Cute Little Worm) who loves to eat (English) words, the app is popular in the age group 3-8 in China.Our company is headquartered in Silicon Valley with a technology office in India and employees spread across the world. Investors in our company are Mumbai Angels, Dr. Aniruddha Malpani, and RTBI - IIT Madras.In the past, Invention Labs has also helped companies with technology consulting and product development, particularly in the medical domain. It has created many successful products for its clients, including innovative blood glucose monitors, a non-invasive thermometer, and low-cost infant warmers.For more information visit our website - avazapp.com or write to us at support@avazapp.com

past.employer_linkedin_description: SASTRA offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes in Engineering, Sciences, Management, Law and Humanities.  SASTRA has been re-accredited (IV Cycle) by the National Assessment & Accreditation Council (NAAC) with a maximum grade of ‘A++’ (3.76/4.00).  Nine of SASTRA’s engineering programmes have also received international accreditation from the Institution of Engineers & Technology (IET), UK.  SASTRA is recognised as a Scientific & Industrial Research Organisation by the Government of India.  SASTRA has been consistently ranked among the top 30 Universities of the country by the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF). The need for a University to be comprehensive in its overall pursuit has been a key input in SASTRA's endeavours to engage in research, teaching, consultancy, training and community outreach activities.  SASTRA has a strong emphasis on research and innovation with several research centres and laboratories dedicated to cutting-edge research in areas such as artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, biotechnology, cyber-physical systems, digital manufacturing, energy & environment, materials science, Indian Knowledge Systems, etc.  The University encourages faculty and learners to engage in research activities and collaborate with industry and academia.  SASTRA has established the SASTRA’s Hub for Research & Innovation (SHRI), which is a multidisciplinary centre with a mandate to translate laboratory innovations to products and for technology development.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian School of Business (ISB) evolved from the need for a world-class business school in Asia. Established in 2001, the ISB has successfully put India on the global map of management education by pioneering several new trends in research, promoting innovation and training and nurturing young leaders who not only have an understanding of the developing economies but the society at large. With two state-of-the-art campuses in Hyderabad and Mohali, ISB provides opportunities to engage with the best of global management practice and thinking. In 2008, ISB became the youngest institution to be ranked among the Top 20 Global B-schools by the Financial Times, London, and since then has been ranked consistently among the top B-schools globally. A proficient pool of research-oriented resident and visiting faculty from top management institutions worldwide provides the essential thrust to ISB’s research milieu. ISB’s strong research acumen has helped produce knowledge and competencies to benefit industry and society, not only in India but across Asia and the rest of the world. Around the world, the School is represented by its network of 17,200+ alumni from the PGP and AMP suites, PGP,PGPMAX, PGPpro, PGP MFAB, AMPBA, AMPH, AMPI, AMPOS, and AMPPP, and the 50,000+ alumni of its Executive Education programmes.Whether it is through innovations in curricula to reflect the shifting business landscape or stimulating experiences and learning outside the classroom, the ISB is committed to providing the best avenue for management education and research to meet the growing need to develop young leaders who can manage global challenges.For more information on the School, visit www.isb.edu Follow us:Twitter: www.twitter.com/ISbeduFacebook: https://www.facebook.com/ISBedu/YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/isbindiaInstagram: https://www.instagram.com/isbindia/Blog: https://blogs.isb.edu/

basic_profile.name: Alok Thampi
basic_profile.headline: Principal Data Engineer at Tiger Analytics
basic_profile.summary: I’ve spent the last 15 years in the world of data - designing and delivering scalable, high-performance data solutions.I specialize in building and modernizing data platforms but my real job is making sure data is accessible, reliable and actually useful for the people who need it. I enjoy the challenge of taking a fragmented data environment and turning it into a streamlined architecture that teams actually enjoy using.What I spend my time on:Building and Modernizing: I am just as comfortable building a brand new data platform from a blank canvas as I am migrating a legacy system into the cloud. While I have hands on experience in Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks and Azure Data Engineering tools, I am ultimately technology-agnostic. My goal is to find the most cost-effective, high-performance fit for the challenge focusing on the right solution rather than a specific tool.Performance and Productivity: Beyond the initial design, I’m passionate about making things run faster and smarter. I specialize in tuning SQL, Spark and data pipelines to ensure maximum reliability. To help teams move quicker, I’ve developed frameworks and accelerators that turn repetitive tasks into efficient, repeatable wins.Security, Governance, and Trust: I believe a data platform is only as good as its integrity. I’ve spent a significant time implementing multi-layered security protocols and crafting governance policies that ensure we aren’t just compliant with regulations, but are true stewards of client data.Global Collaboration and Strategy: I enjoy the human side of tech - whether that’s leading workshops with customers to understand their needs or collaborating with cross-functional teams across the Americas and APAC. I often bridge the gap between technical execution and business strategy, contributing to presales, RFPs, and PoCs to show how the right architecture can solve a client's biggest hurdles.Learning from experience: I’ve seen my share of production mishaps over the years, and those lessons are exactly what allow me to build more resilient, production-proof systems today.The Tech Stuff & Evolution: My core expertise sits within the modern data stack specifically Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric and Azure, with a focus on Lakehouse/Medallion design, DevOps and Power BI integration.Lately, I’ve been bridging the gap between traditional data engineering and AI with focus on Generative AI and LLM implementations.

past.employer_linkedin_description: V. M. Salgaocar e Irmao Ltda. was established in 1942 in Portuguese Goa by our late Founder Chairman, Mr. Vassudev M. Salgaocar. It was later renamed as V. M. Salgaocar & Bro. Pvt. Ltd. (VMSB) and went on to become India’s first vertically integrated mining operation spanning exploration, mechanised ore extraction, processing, multi-modal logistics and export capabilities.Soon after the grant of mining concessions by the Portuguese Government in 1952, the Group exported its first consignment of 16,500 metric tons of iron ore to Nippon Steel Corporation, Japan. Eight years later, the first mechanical screening and loading plant was installed at the mines. The same year, VMSB achieved the export of 1 million tons of iron ore. To keep up with market demand and to promote operational efficiency, S S Sanjeevani, its first self-loading and discharging Transhipper vessel was commissioned in 1971 to load gearless vessels. The following year saw the Group export its first consignment of ore to POSCO (formerly Pohang Iron and Steel Co.) which was also the first cargo to be used in their new blast furnace at Pohang, South Korea. In 1981, VMSB completed the installation of a Beneficiation Plant to promote sustainable mining practices. 1982 saw the commissioning of transhipper M. V. Swatirani to compete with Australian and Brazilian supplies.Since the demise of our Founder Chairman in 1984, the Group has been under the able stewardship of his son, Mr. Shivanand V. Salgaocar.  In 2006, VMSB commissioned the transhipper M. V. Goan Pride as a joint venture with V. S. Dempo & Co (now part of Vedanta Resources Limited).
